Tuku ke fiefia ʻae ngaahi langi, pea nekeneka mo māmani; tuku ke ʻuʻulu ʻae tahi, mo hono fonu ʻo ia.
Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
Ke fiefia ʻae ngoue, mo e meʻa kotoa pē ʻoku ʻi ai: pea ʻe toki fiefia ʻae ngaahi ʻakau kotoa pē ʻoe vao,
Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
‌ʻI he ʻao ʻo Sihova: he ʻoku ne hāʻele mai, he ʻoku hāʻele mai ia ke fakamaau ʻa māmani: te ne fakamaau ʻa māmani ʻi he māʻoniʻoni, mo e kakai ʻi heʻene moʻoni.
Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
‌ʻOku pule ʻa Sihova; tuku ke fiefia ʻa māmani; pea nekeneka ʻae ngaahi ʻotu motu.
The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
‌ʻOku takatakai ia ʻe he ngaahi ʻao mo e fakapoʻuli: ko e angatonu mo e fakamaau ko e tuʻunga ia ʻo hono ʻafioʻanga.
Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
‌ʻOku muʻomuʻa ʻae afi ʻiate ia, pea vela ke ʻosi hono ngaahi fili ʻoku takatakai.
A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
Naʻe fakamaama ʻaki ʻa māmani ʻa hono ngaahi ʻuhila: naʻe mamata ʻae fonua, pea tetetete.
His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
Naʻe vela ʻo vai ʻae ngaahi moʻunga ʻo hangē ko e pulu ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻEiki ʻo māmani kotoa pē.
The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
‌ʻOku fakahā ʻe he ngaahi langi ʻene māʻoniʻoni, pea mamata ʻae kakai kotoa pē ki hono nāunau.
The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
Ke puputuʻu ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku nau tauhi ʻae ngaahi fakatātā kuo tā, mo nau polepole ʻi he ngaahi tamapua: lotu kiate ia, ʻakimoutolu kotoa pē ʻae ngaahi ʻotua.
Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.
Naʻe fanongo ʻa Saione, pea fiefia ai pea naʻe fiefia ʻae ngaahi ʻofefine ʻo Siuta, koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau, ʻE Sihova.
Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
He ko koe, ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ke māʻolunga hake ki māmani kotoa pē: ʻoku ke māʻolunga lahi ʻaupito ʻi he ngaahi ʻotua kotoa pē.
For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
‌ʻAkimoutolu ʻoku ʻofa kia Sihova, mou fehiʻa ki he kovi: ʻoku fakamoʻui ʻe ia ʻae laumālie ʻo ʻene kakai māʻoniʻoni; ʻoku ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu mei he nima ʻoe kau angahala.
Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
Kuo tūtuuʻi ʻae maama maʻae māʻoniʻoni, mo e fiefia maʻae angatonu ʻi loto.
Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
Mou fiefia ʻia Sihova ʻae kau angatonu; pea fakafetaʻi ʻi he manatu ki heʻene māʻoniʻoni.
Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
Hiva kia Sihova ʻaki ʻae hiva foʻou; he kuo fai ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi meʻa fakaofo: kuo ne ikuna ʻaki hono nima toʻomataʻu, mo hono nima māʻoniʻoni.
O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
Kuo fakahā ʻe Sihova ʻa ʻene fakamoʻui: kuo ne fakahā atu ʻene māʻoniʻoni ʻi he ʻao ʻoe hiteni.
The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
Kuo ne manatu ki heʻene ʻaloʻofa mo ʻene moʻoni ki he fale ʻo ʻIsileli: kuo mamata ʻe he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻo māmani ki he fakamoʻui ʻa hotau ʻOtua.
He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
Kalanga ʻi he fiefia kia Sihova, ʻa māmani kotoa pē: kalanga ʻi he leʻo lahi, mo fiefia, pea hiva fakamālō.
Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
Hiva kia Sihova ʻaki ʻae haʻape; ʻaki ʻae haʻape, pea mo e leʻo ʻoe saame.
Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
Mou kalanga fakafiefia ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻalea mo e leʻo ʻoe meʻalea, ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova ko e Tuʻi.
With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
Tuku ke ʻuʻulu ʻae tahi, mo hono fonu ʻo ia; ʻa māmani, mo kinautolu ʻoku nofo ai.
Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
Ke pasipasi ʻe he ngaahi vai ʻa honau nima: tuku ke fiefia fakataha ʻae ngaahi moʻunga,
Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
‌ʻI he ʻao ʻo Sihova; he ʻoku hāʻele mai ia ke fakamaau ʻa māmani: te ne fakamaau ʻa māmani ʻi he māʻoniʻoni, pea mo e kakai ʻi he angatonu.
Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
‌ʻOku pule ʻa Sihova; tuku ke tetetete ʻae kakai: ʻoku ʻafio ia ʻi he vahaʻa ʻoe ongo selupi; tuku ke ngalulu ʻa māmani.
The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
‌ʻOku lahi ʻa Sihova ʻi Saione; pea ʻoku māʻolunga lahi ia ʻi he kakai kotoa pē.
The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
Tuku kenau fakamālō ki ho huafa lahi mo fakailifia; he ʻoku māʻoniʻoni ia.
Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
‌ʻOku ʻofa foki ʻae mālohi ʻoe tuʻi ki he fakamaau; ʻoku ke fokotuʻumaʻu ʻae fai totonu, ʻoku ke fai ʻae fakamaau mo e māʻoniʻoni ʻia Sēkope.
The king’s strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
Mou fakahikihiki ʻa Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua, pea lotu ʻi hono tuʻunga vaʻe; he ʻoku māʻoniʻoni ia.
Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
Ko Mōsese mo ʻElone ʻi heʻene kau taulaʻeiki, pea mo Samuela ʻiate kinautolu ʻoku ui ki hono huafa; naʻa nau ui kia Sihova, pea ne talia ʻakinautolu.
Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
Naʻa ne folofola kiate kinautolu ʻi he pou ʻoe ʻao: naʻa nau tauhi ʻene ngaahi fakamoʻoni, mo e tuʻutuʻuni naʻa ne fokotuʻu kiate kinautolu.
He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
‌ʻE Sihova ko homau ʻOtua, naʻa ke talia ʻakinautolu: ko koe ko e ʻOtua naʻa ke fakamolemolea ʻakinautolu, neongo hoʻo totongi koeʻuhi ko ʻenau ngaahi fakakaukau.
Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
Fakahikihiki ʻa Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua, pea lotu ʻi hono moʻunga tapu; he ʻoku māʻoniʻoni ʻa Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua.
Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.
Mou mavava ʻi he fiefia kia Sihova, ʻae ngaahi fonua kotoa pē.
Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
Tauhi ʻa Sihova ʻi he fiefia: haʻu mo e hiva ki hono ʻao.
Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
Mou ʻilo ko Sihova ko ia pe ko e ʻOtua: ko ia pe naʻa ne ngaohi ʻakitautolu, ka naʻe ʻikai te tau ngaohi ʻakitautolu; ko hono kakai ʻakitautolu, mo e fanga sipi ʻo ʻene ngoue.
Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
Hū ʻi hono ngaahi matapā mo e fakafetaʻi, pea ki hono ngaahi lotoʻā mo e fakamālō: mou fakafetaʻi kiate ia, pea fakamālō ki hono huafa.
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
He ʻoku angalelei ʻa Sihova; ʻoku taʻengata ʻene ʻaloʻofa; pea ʻoku tolonga maʻuaipē ʻene moʻoni mei he toʻutangata ki he toʻutangata.
For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
Te u hiva ʻaki ʻae ʻaloʻofa mo e fakamaau: ‌ʻE Sihova, te u hiva kiate koe.
I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
Te u fai fakapotopoto ʻi he hala haohaoa. Te ke hāʻele mai ʻafē kiate au? Te u ʻeveʻeva ʻi hoku fale ʻi he loto haohaoa.
I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
‌ʻE ʻikai te u tuku ha meʻa kovi ʻi hoku ʻao: ʻoku ou fehiʻa ki he ngāue ʻanautolu kuo nau afe; ʻE ʻikai pipiki ia kiate au.
I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
‌ʻE ʻalu ʻiate au ʻaia ʻoku loto kovi: ʻE ʻikai te u ʻiloʻi ha taha ʻoku kovi.
A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
Ko ia ʻoku fakakovi fakafufū hono kaungāʻapi, te u tuʻusi ia: ko ia ʻoku fiematamuʻa mo loto laukau ʻe ʻikai te u kātakiʻi.
Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
‌ʻE sio maʻu hoku mata ki he kakai angatonu ʻi he fonua, koeʻuhi ke mau nonofo mo au: ko ia ʻoku ʻeveʻeva ʻi he hala haohaoa, ko ia ia ʻe tauhi au.
Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
Ko ia ʻoku ne fai kākā ʻe ʻikai nofo ia ʻi hoku fale: ko ia ʻoku faʻa loi ʻe ʻikai te ne nofo ʻi hoku ʻao.
He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
‌ʻE vave ʻeku fakaʻauha ʻae kau angahala kotoa pē ʻoe fonua; koeʻuhi ke u tuʻusi ʻae kakai fai kovi kotoa pē mei he kolo ʻa Sihova.
I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
‌ʻE Sihova, fanongo ki heʻeku lotu, pea tuku ke aʻu atu ʻeku tangi kiate koe.
Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.
‌ʻOua naʻa ke fufū ho fofonga ʻiate au ʻi he ʻaho ʻoku ou mamahi ai; fakatokangaʻi ho fofonga kiate au: ʻi he ʻaho ʻoku ou ui ai ke vave hoʻo talia au.
Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
He kuo fakaʻosi hoku ngaahi ʻaho ʻo hangē ko e kohu, pea kuo vela hoku ngaahi hui ʻo hangē ko e veʻe tofunanga.
For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
Kuo taaʻi hoku loto, pea kuo mae ʻo hangē ko e mohuku; ko ia kuo ngalo ai ʻiate au ke kai ʻeku mā.
My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
Koeʻuhi ko e leʻo ʻo ʻeku toʻe, ko ia ʻoku piki ai hoku ngaahi hui ki hoku kili.
By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
‌ʻOku ou tatau mo e pelikani ʻoe toafa: ʻoku ou hangē ko e lulu ʻoe potu lala.
I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
‌ʻOku ou leʻo, pea u tatau mo e kihiʻi manupuna ʻoku tokotaha pē ʻi he tuʻahivi ʻoe fale.
I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
‌ʻOku manuki kiate au ʻa hoku ngaahi fili ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē; pea ko kinautolu ʻoku mata lili kiate au kuo nau fuakava ke angatuʻu kiate au.
Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
He kuo u kai ʻae efuefu ʻo hangē ko e mā, mo huʻi ʻaki hoku inu ʻae loʻimata,
For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
Koeʻuhi ko ho tuputāmaki mo ho houhau: he kuo ke hiki hake au, pea lī au ki lalo.
Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
‌ʻOku tatau hoku ngaahi ʻaho mo e ʻata ʻoku mole atu; pea kuo u mae ʻo hangē ko e mohuku.
My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
Ka ko koe, ʻE Sihova, te ke tolonga ʻo taʻengata; mo hoʻo fakaʻilonga ki he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē.
But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
Te ke tuʻu hake, mo ke ʻaloʻofa ki Saione: he ko e ʻaho ke tokoni ia, ʻio, ko e ʻaho kuo tuʻutuʻuni kuo hoko mai.
Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
He ʻoku fiemālie ʻa hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki ʻi hono ngaahi maka, pea ʻoku nau ʻofa ki hono efu ʻoʻona.
For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
Ko ia ʻe manavahē ai ʻae hiteni ki he huafa ʻo Sihova, pea ko e ngaahi tuʻi kotoa pē ʻo māmani ki ho nāunau.
So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
‌ʻOka toe langa hake ʻe Sihova ʻa Saione, ʻe fakahā ia ʻi hono nāunau.
When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
Te ne tokanga ki he lotu ʻae masiva, pea ʻe ʻikai manukiʻi ʻenau hū.
He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
‌ʻE tohi eni maʻae toʻutangata ʻe haʻu: pea ko e kakai ʻe fakatupu te nau fakamālō kia Sihova.
This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
He kuo ʻafio hifo ia mei he māʻolunga ʻo hono faletapu; naʻe ʻafio ʻa Sihova mei he langi ki māmani;
For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
Ke ne fanongo ki he toʻe ʻoe pōpula; ke vete ʻakinautolu kuo tuʻutuʻuni ke mate;
To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
Ke fakahā ʻae huafa ʻo Sihova ʻi Saione, mo ʻene fakamālō ʻi Selūsalema;
To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
‌ʻOka fakataha ʻae kakai, pea mo e ngaahi puleʻanga, ke tauhi ʻa Sihova.
When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
Naʻa ne fakavaivaiʻi hoku mālohi ʻi he hala; naʻa ne fakanounou hoku ngaahi ʻaho.
He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
Naʻaku pehē, ʻE hoku ʻOtua, ʻoua naʻa ʻave au ʻi he lotolotonga ʻo hoku ngaahi ʻaho: ko ho ngaahi taʻu ʻoku tolonga ki he toʻutangata kotoa pē.
I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
Naʻa ke ʻai ʻi he kamataʻanga ʻae tuʻunga ʻo māmani; pea koe ngaahi langi koe ngaue ia ʻa ho nima.
Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
‌ʻE ʻauha ia, ka ʻe pehē ai pe ʻa koe, ʻio, ʻe fakaʻaʻau kotoa pē ia ke motuʻa ʻo hangē ko e kofu; pea hangē ko e pulupulu te ke fatufatu ia, pea ʻe fakakehe ia:
They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
Ka ʻe pehē ai pe ʻa koe, pea ʻe ʻikai hano ngataʻanga ʻo ho ngaahi taʻu.
But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
‌ʻE tolonga ʻae fānau ʻa hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki, pea ʻe fokotuʻumaʻu honau hako ʻi ho ʻao.
The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova ʻa hoku laumālie: pea mo ia kotoa pē ʻoku ʻiate au, fakafetaʻi ki hono huafa māʻoniʻoni.
Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻa hoku laumālie, pea ʻoua naʻa ngalo ʻa ʻene ngaahi meʻaʻofa kotoa pē:
Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
‌ʻAia ʻoku ne fakamolemole hoʻo ngaahi hia kotoa pē; mo ne fakamoʻui ho ngaahi mahaki kotoa pē;
Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
‌ʻAia ʻoku ne huhuʻi hoʻo moʻui mei he fakaʻauha; ʻo ne tatā ʻaki koe ʻae manavaʻofa mo e ʻaloʻofa ongongofua;
Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
‌ʻAia ʻoku ne fakamākona ʻaki ho ngutu ʻae ngaahi meʻa lelei; ko ia kuo toe tupulaki ai ho talavou ʻo hangē ko e ʻikale.
Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
‌ʻOku fai ʻe Sihova ʻae māʻoniʻoni mo e fakamaau kiate kinautolu kotoa pē kuo fakamālohia.
The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
Naʻa ne fakahā hono ngaahi hala kia Mōsese, mo ʻene ngaahi ngāue ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli.
He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
‌ʻOku manavaʻofa mo angalelei ʻa Sihova, ʻoku faʻa kātaki, pea mohu ʻaloʻofa.
The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
‌ʻE ʻikai te ne valoki maʻuaipē: pea ʻe ʻikai tuputāmaki ʻo taʻengata.
He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
Naʻe ʻikai fai ʻe ia kiate kitautolu ʻo fakatatau mo ʻetau ngaahi angahala; pe totongi kiate kitautolu ʻo fakatatau mo ʻetau ngaahi hia.
He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
Kae hangē ko hono māʻolunga ʻoe langi ki māmani, ʻoku pehē hono lahi ʻo ʻene ʻaloʻofa kiate kinautolu ʻoku nau manavahē kiate ia.
For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
‌ʻOku hangē ko hono vā mamaʻo ʻoe potu hahake mei he potu lulunga, ʻoku pehē hono mamaʻo ʻo ʻene ʻave ʻetau ngaahi angahala ʻiate kitautolu.
As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
Pea hangē ʻoku manavaʻofa ʻae tamai ki heʻene fānau, ʻoku pehē ʻae manavaʻofa ʻa Sihova kiate kinautolu ʻoku nau manavahē kiate ia.
Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
He ʻoku ne ʻiloʻi hotau anga; ʻoku ne manatu ko e efu pe ʻakitautolu.
For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
Pea ko e tangata, ʻoku tatau hono ngaahi ʻaho mo e mohuku: pea hangē ko e fisiʻi ʻakau ʻoe ngoue hono lau maʻuiʻui.
As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
He ʻoku ʻalu atu ki ai ʻae matangi, pea kuo ʻikai ia; pea ʻe ʻikai siʻi toe ʻilo ia ʻi hono potu.
For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
Ka ko e ʻaloʻofa ʻa Sihova ʻoku talu mei muʻa ʻo aʻu ʻo taʻengata kiate kinautolu ʻoku nau manavahē kiate ia, pea ko ʻene māʻoniʻoni ki he fānau ʻae fānau;
But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;
Kiate kinautolu ʻoku nau tauhi ʻene fuakava, pea mo kinautolu ʻoku nau manatu ki heʻene ngaahi fekau ke fai ki ai.
To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
Kuo teuteu ʻe Sihova hono ʻafioʻanga ʻi he ngaahi langi; pea ʻoku pule hono puleʻanga ki he meʻa kotoa pē.
The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova ʻakimoutolu ko ʻene kau ʻāngelo, ʻoku lahi homou mālohi, pea ʻoku mou fai ʻene ngaahi fekau, ʻo fakafanongo ki he leʻo ʻo ʻene folofola.
Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻakimoutolu kotoa pē ko ʻene ngaahi kautau; ʻakimoutolu ko ʻene kau faifekau, ʻoku mou fai ki hono finangalo.
Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻa ʻene ngaahi ngāue kotoa pē ʻi he potu kotoa pē ʻo hono puleʻanga: fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻa hoku laumālie.
Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻa hoku laumālie. ʻE Sihova ko hoku ʻOtua, ʻoku ke lahi ʻaupito; kuo kofuʻaki koe ʻae fakaʻapaʻapa mo e māfimafi.
Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
‌ʻOku ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki koe ʻae maama ʻo hangē ko e kofu: ʻoku ke fofola atu ʻae ngaahi langi ʻo hangē ko e puipui:
Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
‌ʻOku ne ʻai ʻae ngaahi utupoto ʻo hono ngaahi fale ʻi he ngaahi vai: pea ko ʻene saliote ʻae ngaahi ʻao: pea ʻoku hāʻele ia ʻi he ngaahi kapakau ʻoe matangi:
Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
‌ʻOku ne ngaohi ʻene kau ʻāngelo ke hangē ko e matangi; mo ʻene kau faifekau ko e afi ʻoku ulo:
Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
Naʻa ne ʻai ʻae ngaahi tuʻunga ʻo māmani, ke ʻoua naʻa ueʻi ia ʻo lauikuonga.
Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
‌ʻOku ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ia ʻae loloto ʻo hangē ko e kofu: naʻe tuʻu ʻae ngaahi vai ʻo māʻolunga hake ʻi he ngaahi moʻunga.
Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
‌ʻI hoʻo valoki naʻa nau puna; ʻi he leʻo ʻo hoʻo fatulisi naʻa nau hola ai.
At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
‌ʻOku nau ʻalu hake ʻi he ngaahi moʻunga, pea nau ʻalu hifo ʻi he ngaahi vahaʻa moʻunga, ki he potu kuo ke teuteu ki ai.
They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
Kuo ke ʻai hono ngataʻanga ke ʻoua naʻa ʻalu atu ia ʻi ai; koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa toe haʻu ia ke lōfia ʻa māmani.
Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
‌ʻOku ne fekau atu ʻae ngaahi matavai ʻi he ngaahi luo, ʻaia ʻoku tafe ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe ngaahi foʻi moʻunga.
He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
‌ʻOku inu mei ai ʻae fanga manu kotoa pē ʻoe vao: pea ʻoku inu ʻo fiu ai ʻae fanga ʻasi hehengi.
They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
‌ʻOku maʻu ʻi ai ʻe he manupuna ʻoe ʻatā honau nofoʻanga, ʻoku nau hiva ʻi he ngaahi vaʻa.
By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
‌ʻOku ne fakaviviku ʻae ngaahi foʻi moʻunga mei hono fale ʻafioʻanga: ʻoku mākona ʻae kelekele ʻi he fua ʻo hoʻo ngaahi ngāue.
He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
‌ʻOku fakatupu ʻe ia ʻae mohuku maʻae fanga manu, mo e ʻakau ke ʻaonga ki he tangata: koeʻuhi ke ne ʻomi ʻae meʻakai mei he kelekele;
He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
Mo e uaine ʻaia ʻoku fakafiefiaʻi ʻae loto ʻoe tangata, mo e lolo ke fakangingila hono mata, mo e mā ke fakamālohi ʻae loto ʻoe tangata.
And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.
‌ʻOku fonu ʻi he huhuʻa ʻae ngaahi ʻakau ʻo Sihova; ko e ngaahi sita ʻo Lepanoni, ʻaia kuo ne tō;
The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
‌ʻOku ngaohi ʻi ai ʻe he fanga manupuna honau pununga: pea ko e sitoaka, ko hono fale ko e ngaahi ʻakau ko e paini.
Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
Ko e ngaahi foʻi moʻunga māʻolunga ko e hūfanga ia ʻoe fanga kosi hehengi; pea mo e ngaahi maka ki he fanga koni.
The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
Naʻa ne tuʻutuʻuni ʻae māhina ki he ngaahi faʻahitaʻu: ʻoku ʻiloʻi ʻe he laʻā hono tōʻanga.
He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
‌ʻOku ke ngaohi ʻae poʻuli, pea ko e pō ia: pea ʻoku totolo atu ʻi ai ʻae fanga manu kotoa pē ʻoe vao.
Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
‌ʻOku ngungulu ʻae fanga laione mui ke maʻu ʻenau meʻa, pea nau kumi ʻenau meʻakai mei he ʻOtua.
The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
‌ʻOku hopo hake ʻae laʻā, pea ʻoku nau fakataha ai, ʻonau tokoto ʻi honau ngaahi ʻana.
The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
‌ʻOku ʻalu atu ʻae tangata ki heʻene ngāue, mo ʻene ngoue ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
‌ʻE Sihova, hono ʻikai lahi ʻa hoʻo ngaahi ngāue! Kuo ke ngaohi kotoa pē ia ʻi he poto: ʻoku fonu ʻa māmani ʻi hoʻo koloa.
O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
Pea ʻoku pehē ʻae tahi lahi ni mo laulahi, ʻa ia ʻoku ai ʻae ngaahi meʻa totolo taʻefaʻalaua, ʻae fanga ika iiki mo e lalahi.
So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
‌ʻOku ʻalu ʻi ai ʻae ngaahi vaka: ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae levaiatani ko ia, ʻaia kuo ke ngaohi ke ne fakavā ai.
There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
‌ʻOku tatali ʻakinautolu ni kotoa pē kiate koe: koeʻuhi ke ke foaki kiate kinautolu ʻenau meʻakai ʻi he feituʻulaʻā totonu.
These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
Ko ia ʻoku ke foaki kiate kinautolu ʻoku nau tānaki: ʻoku ke mafola ho nima, pea ʻoku pito ʻakinautolu ʻi he lelei.
That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
‌ʻOku ke fufū ho fofonga, pea nau mamahi ai: ʻoku ke toʻo atu ʻenau mānava, pea nau mate, pea foki ki honau efu.
Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
‌ʻOku ke fekau atu ho Laumālie, pea ʻoku fakatupu ai ʻakinautolu: pea ʻoku ke fakafoʻou ʻae funga ʻo māmani.
Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
‌ʻE tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻae nāunau ʻo Sihova: ʻe fiefia ʻa Sihova ʻi heʻene ngaahi ngāue.
The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
‌ʻOku ʻafio ia ki māmani, pea tetetete ia: ʻoku ala ia ki he ngaahi foʻi moʻunga, pea ʻoku nau kohu ai.
He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
Te u hiva kia Sihova ʻi heʻeku kei moʻui: te u hiva fakamālō ki hoku ʻOtua ʻi he lolotonga ʻo ʻeku moʻui.
I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
‌ʻE melie ʻa ʻeku fakakaukau kiate ia: te u fiefia ʻia Sihova.
My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
Tuku ke ʻosiʻosingamālie ʻae kakai angahala mei māmani, pea ʻoua naʻa kei toe ʻae kau angakovi. Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻa hoku laumālie. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova; ui ki hono huafa: fakahā ʻene ngaahi ngāue ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai.
O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
Hiva kiate ia, hiva ʻaki ʻae ngaahi saame kiate ia: mou talanoa ʻaki ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo kotoa pē.
Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
Mou vikiviki ʻi hono huafa māʻoniʻoni: tuku ke fiefia ʻae loto ʻokinautolu ʻoku nau kumi kia Sihova.
Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
Kumi kia Sihova, mo hono mālohi: kumi maʻuaipē ki hono fofonga.
Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
Manatu ki heʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ʻaia kuo ne fai; ʻa ʻene ngaahi mana, mo e ngaahi fakamaau ʻa hono fofonga;
Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
‌ʻAkimoutolu ʻae hako ʻo ʻEpalahame ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki, ʻakimoutolu ʻae fānau ʻa Sēkope ʻaia kuo ne fili.
O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
Ko ia, ko Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua, ʻoku ʻi māmani kotoa pē ʻa ʻene ngaahi fakamaau.
He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
Kuo manatu ʻe ia ki heʻene fuakava ʻo lauikuonga, ko e folofola ʻaia naʻa ne fekau ki he toʻutangata ʻe taha afe.
He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
‌ʻA e fuakava ʻaia naʻa ne fai mo ʻEpalahame, pea mo ʻene fuakava kia ʻAisake;
Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
Pea ne fokotuʻumaʻu ia kia Sēkope ko e fono, pea kia ʻIsileli ko e fuakava taʻengata:
And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
‌ʻO ne pehē, “Te u foaki kiate koe ʻae fonua ko Kēnani, ko e fuofua ʻo homou tofiʻa:”
Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
‌ʻI he lolotonga naʻe tokosiʻi pe honau kau tangata; ʻio, ko e tokosiʻi ʻaupito, mo e kau muli ʻi ai.
When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
Lolotonga ʻa ʻenau ʻalu mei he faʻahinga ʻe taha ki ha faʻahinga kehe, pea mei he puleʻanga ʻe taha ki he kakai kehe;
When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
Naʻe ʻikai tuku ʻe ia ke fai kovi ʻe ha tangata ʻe taha kiate kinautolu: ʻio, naʻa ne valoki ʻae ngaahi tuʻi koeʻuhi ko kinautolu;
He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
ʻO ne pehē, “ʻOua naʻa ala kiate ia kuo u pani, pea ʻoua naʻa fai kovi ki heʻeku kau palōfita.”
Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
Pea naʻa ne ui foki ke hoko ʻae honge ki he fonua: naʻa ne fesiʻi ʻae tokotoko kotoa pē ʻoe mā,
Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
Naʻa ne fekau ʻae tangata ke muʻomuʻa ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ko Siosefa ʻaia naʻe fakatau ke tamaioʻeiki:
He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
Pea naʻa nau fakamamahiʻi hono vaʻe ʻaki ʻae ngaahi haʻi: naʻe tuia ia ʻe he ukamea:
Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
‌ʻO aʻu ki he ʻaho naʻe hoko ai ʻene lea: naʻe ʻahiʻahiʻi ia ʻe he folofola ʻa Sihova.
Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
Naʻe fekau ʻe he tuʻi ke vete ia; ʻio, ʻe he pule ʻoe kakai, pea naʻa ne tukuange ia ke tauʻatāina pe.
The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
Naʻa ne fakanofo ia ko e ʻeiki ʻo hono fale, mo e pule ʻo ʻene koloa kotoa pē:
He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
Ke haʻisia hono ngaahi ʻeiki ko ʻene faʻiteliha; mo akonakiʻi ʻa ʻene kau mātuʻa ʻi he poto.
To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
Naʻe haʻu foki ʻa ʻIsileli ki ʻIsipite pea naʻe ʻāunofo ʻa Sēkope ʻi he fonua ʻo Hami.
Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
Pea naʻa ne fakatupu ʻo tokolahi ʻaupito ʻa hono kakai; pea ne ngaohi ʻakinautolu kenau mālohi hake ʻi honau ngaahi fili.
And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
Naʻa ne liliu honau loto kenau fehiʻa ki hono kakai, kenau fai kākā ki heʻene kau tamaioʻeiki.
He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
Naʻa ne fekau atu ʻa Mōsese ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki; mo ʻElone ʻaia naʻa ne fili.
He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
Naʻa ne fakahā hono ngaahi fakaʻilonga ʻiate kinautolu, mo e ngaahi meʻa mana ʻi he fonua ʻo Hami.
They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
Naʻe fekau ʻe ia ki he fakapoʻuli, pea ngaohi ia ko e poʻuli; pea naʻe ʻikai angatuʻu ʻakinautolu ki heʻene folofola.
He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
Naʻa ne liliu honau ngaahi vai ko e toto, mo tāmateʻi ʻenau ika.
He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
Naʻe tupu ʻi honau fonua ʻae fanga poto ʻo lahi ʻaupito, ʻi he ngaahi loki ʻo honau ngaahi tuʻi.
Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
Naʻe folofola ia, pea naʻe haʻu ʻae ngaahi lango kehekehe, mo e fanga kutu ʻi honau fonua.
He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
Naʻa ne ʻomi ʻae ʻuha maka kiate kinautolu ko e fetongi ʻoe ʻuha, mo e afi ʻoku ulo ʻi honau fonua.
He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
Naʻa ne taaʻi foki ʻenau ngaahi vaine, mo ʻenau ngaahi ʻakau ko e fiki; pea fesiʻi ʻae ngaahi ʻakau ʻo honau fonua.
He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
Naʻa ne folofola, pea naʻe haʻu ai ʻae fanga heʻe, mo e ngaahi ʻunufe ʻoku taʻefaʻalaua.
He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
Pea naʻa nau kai ke ʻosi ʻae ngaahi ʻakau kotoa pē ʻi honau fonua, pea nau fakaʻauha ʻae fua ʻo ʻenau ngoue.
And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
Naʻa ne taaʻi foki ʻae ʻuluaki fānau kotoa pē ʻi honau fonua, ko e fungani ʻo ʻenau mālohi kotoa pē.
He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
Naʻa ne ʻomi foki ʻakinautolu mo e siliva mo e koula: pea naʻe ʻikai ai ha tokotaha naʻe vaivai ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga.
He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
Naʻe fiefia ʻa ʻIsipite ʻi heʻenau ʻalu hē naʻe tō kiate kinautolu ʻae manavahē koeʻuhi ko kinautolu.
Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
Naʻa ne fofola ʻae ʻao ko e fakamalu pea mo e afi ke fakamaama ʻi he pō.
He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
Naʻe kole ʻe he kakai, pea naʻa ne ʻomi ʻae fanga manupuna, mo ne fakamākona ʻaki ʻakinautolu ʻae mā ʻoe langi.
The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
Naʻa ne fakaava ʻae maka, pea ʻoho mai ʻae ngaahi vai; pea naʻe tafe ia ʻi he ngaahi potu mōmoa ʻo hangē ko e vaitafe.
He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
He naʻa ne manatu ki heʻene talaʻofa māʻoniʻoni, mo ʻEpalahame ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki.
For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
Pea ne ʻomi hono kakai ʻi he fiefia, mo kinautolu kuo ne fili ʻi he nekeneka:
And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
Pea ne foaki kiate kinautolu ʻae ngaahi fonua ʻoe hiteni, pea naʻa nau maʻu ʻae ngāue ʻae kakai
And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
Koeʻuhi kenau tokanga ki heʻene ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni, mo tauhi ʻene ngaahi fekau. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.
Mou fakamālō kia Sihova. Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova; he ʻoku angalelei ia: koeʻuhi ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Ko hai ʻe faʻa fakamatala ki he ngaahi ngāue lahi ʻa Sihova? Ko hai ʻe faʻa fakahā ʻae fakamālō kotoa pē kiate ia?
Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?
‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻakinautolu ʻoku tokanga ki he fakamaau, mo ia ʻoku fai māʻoniʻoni ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.
Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
‌ʻE Sihova, ke ke manatuʻi au ʻaki ʻae ʻofa ʻaia ʻoku ke ʻofa ʻaki ki hoʻo kakai: ke ke ʻaʻahi mai kiate au ʻaki hoʻo fakamoʻui;
Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
Koeʻuhi ke u mamata ki he lelei ʻo ia kuo ke fili, koeʻuhi ke u fiefia ʻi he fiefia ʻo ho puleʻanga, pea u vikiviki ai fakataha mo ho tofiʻa.
That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
Ko kimautolu mo ʻemau ngaahi tamai kuo mau fai angahala, kuo mau fai ʻae ngaahi hia, kuo mau fai kovi.
We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

Naʻe ʻikai ʻilo ʻe heʻemau ngaahi tamai hoʻo ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ʻi ʻIsipite; naʻe ʻikai tenau manatu ki hono lahi ʻo hoʻo ngaahi ʻaloʻofa; ka naʻa nau fakahouhau kiate ia ʻi he tahi, ʻio, ʻi he Tahi Kulokula.
Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
Ka naʻa ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu koeʻuhi ko hono huafa, koeʻuhi ke ne fakaʻilo ʻa hono mālohi lahi.
Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
Naʻe valoki foki ʻe ia ʻae Tahi Kulokula, pea mōmoa ia: ko ia naʻa ne tataki ʻakinautolu ʻi he loloto, ʻo hangē ko e toafa.
He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
Pea naʻa ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu mei he nima ʻo ia naʻe fehiʻa kiate kinautolu, mo ne huhuʻi ʻakinautolu mei he nima ʻoe fili.
And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
Pea naʻe lōmakiʻi honau ngaahi fili ʻaki ʻae ngaahi vai: pea naʻe ʻikai hao ha tokotaha ʻiate kinautolu.
And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
Pea naʻa nau toki tui ki heʻene folofola; naʻa nau hiva ʻaki ʻae fakamālō kiate ia.
Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
Naʻe ngalo leva ʻiate kinautolu ʻene ngaahi ngāue; pea naʻe ʻikai tenau tatali ki heʻene akonaki:
They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
Ka naʻa nau holi kovi ʻaupito ʻi he toafa, pea ʻahiʻahiʻi ʻae ʻOtua ʻi he potu lala.
But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
Pea naʻa ne foaki kiate kinautolu ʻaia naʻa nau kole; ka naʻa ne fekau ʻae tutue ki honau laumālie.
And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
Naʻa nau meheka foki kia Mōsese ʻi he loto ʻapitanga, mo ʻElone ko e tokotaha māʻoniʻoni ʻa Sihova.
They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.
Naʻe mafahi ʻae kelekele pea folo hifo ai ʻa Tatani, mo ʻufiʻufi ai ʻae kakai ʻo ʻEpilami.
The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
Pea naʻe tutu ai ʻae afi ʻi honau kakai; pea vela ke ʻosi ʻe he ulo afi ʻae kau angahala.
And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
Naʻa nau ngaohi ʻae fakatātā ʻoe ʻuhikiʻi pulu ʻi Holepi, pea lotu ki he fakatātā koula.
They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
Naʻe pehē ʻenau liliu honau nāunau, ki he fakatātā ʻoe pulu ʻaia ʻoku kai mohuku.
Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
Naʻa nau fakangalongaloʻi ʻae ʻOtua ko honau fakamoʻui, ʻaia naʻe fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi ʻi ʻIsipite;
They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
Ko e ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ʻi he fonua ʻo Hami, mo e ngaahi meʻa fakailifia ʻi he Tahi Kulokula.
Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
Ko ia naʻa ne pehē te ne fakaʻauha ʻakinautolu, ka ne ʻikai tuʻu ʻi hono ʻao ʻi he vahaʻa ʻa Mōsese ʻaia kuo ne fili, ke fakatafoki hono houhau, telia naʻa fakaʻauha ʻe ia ʻakinautolu.
Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
‌ʻIo, naʻa nau fehiʻa ki he fonua lelei, naʻe ʻikai tenau tui ki heʻene folofola:
Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
Ka naʻa nau lāunga ʻi honau ngaahi fale fehikitaki, ʻo taʻetokanga ki he leʻo ʻo Sihova.
But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
Ko ia naʻa ne hiki hake ai hono nima kiate kinautolu, ke tulaki ʻakinautolu ʻi he toafa:
Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
Ke tulaki foki honau hako ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ngaahi puleʻanga, mo fakahēʻi ʻakinautolu ʻi he ngaahi fonua.
To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
Naʻa nau ului foki kia Peali-Peoli, mo nau kai ʻae ngaahi feilaulau ʻoe mate.
They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
Ko ia naʻa nau fakahouhauʻi ia ʻaki ʻenau ngaahi filioʻi: pea naʻe ʻoho mai ʻae mahaki fakaʻauha kiate kinautolu.
Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
Pea naʻe toki tuʻu hake ʻa Finiasi, ʻo fai ʻae fakamaau: pea naʻe lolomi ai ʻae mahaki fakaʻauha.
Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
Pea naʻe lau ia kiate ia ko e māʻoniʻoni ʻi he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē ʻo lauikuonga.
And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
Naʻa nau fakahouhau kiate ia foki ʻi he ngaahi vai ʻoe fekeʻikeʻi, pea hoko ʻae kovi kia Mōsese koeʻuhi ko kinautolu:
They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
Ko e meʻa ʻi heʻenau fakatupu hono loto, ko ia naʻa ne lea ʻaki ʻae lea taʻengali ʻe hono loungutu.
Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
Naʻe ʻikai tenau fakaʻauha ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga, ʻaia naʻe fekau ʻe Sihova kiate kinautolu:
They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:
Ka naʻa nau nofo fakataha mo e hiteni, pea nau ʻilo ʻenau ngaahi ngāue.
But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
Pea naʻa nau tauhi honau ngaahi tamapua: ʻaia naʻe hoko ko e tauhele kiate kinautolu.
And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
‌ʻIo, naʻa nau feilaulau ʻaki honau ngaahi foha mo honau ngaahi ʻofefine ki he kau tēvolo,
Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
Mo lilingi ʻae toto māʻoniʻoni, ko e toto ʻo honau ngaahi foha mo honau ngaahi ʻofefine, ʻakinautolu naʻa nau feilaulau ʻaki ki he ngaahi tamapua ʻo ʻi he toto.
And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
Pea naʻe fakaʻuliʻi pehē ʻakinautolu ʻi heʻenau ngaahi ngāue, pea nau fai feʻauaki ʻi heʻenau ngaahi filioʻi.
Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
Ko ia naʻe tupu ai ʻae houhau ʻo Sihova ki hono kakai, pea ne fākaliliʻa ai ki hono tofiʻa ʻoʻona.
Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
Pea naʻa ne tukuange ʻakinautolu ki he nima ʻoe hiteni; pea naʻe pule kiate kinautolu ʻakinautolu naʻe fehiʻa kiate kinautolu.
And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
Pea naʻe fakamālohiʻi ʻakinautolu ʻe honau ngaahi fili, pea fakamoʻulaloa ʻakinautolu ki honau lalo nima.
Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
Naʻe liunga lahi ʻene fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu; ka naʻa nau fakahouhauʻi ia ʻi heʻenau fakakaukau, pea naʻe fakavaivaiʻi ʻakinautolu koeʻuhi ko ʻenau hia.
Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
Ka naʻa ne tokanga ki heʻenau mamahi, ʻi heʻene ongoʻi ʻenau tangi:
Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
Pea ne manatuʻi ʻa ʻene fuakava mo kinautolu, pea ne fakatomala ʻo fakatatau mo hono lahi ʻo ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
naʻa ne pule foki ke manavaʻofa kiate kinautolu ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe ʻave pōpula ʻakinautolu.
He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
Fakamoʻui ʻakimautolu, ʻE Sihova ko homau ʻOtua, pea tānaki ʻakimautolu mei he lotolotonga ʻoe hiteni, ke mau fakafetaʻi ki ho huafa māʻoniʻoni, pea hanuhanu ʻi he fakamālō kiate koe.
Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova koe ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli talu mei muʻa ʻo aʻu ʻo taʻengata; pea tuku ke lea pehē ʻe he kakai kotoa pē ʻEmeni. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.
“Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, he ʻoku angalelei ia: koeʻuhi ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.”
O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Ke lea pehē ʻe he kakai kuo huhuʻi ʻe Sihova, ʻakinautolu kuo ne huhuʻi mei he nima ʻoe fili;
Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
Pea tānaki ʻakinautolu mei he ngaahi fonua, mei he potu hahake, pea mei he potu lulunga, mei he potu tokelau, pea mei he feituʻu tonga.
And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
Naʻa nau ʻalu fano pē ʻi he toafa ʻi he hala liʻaki; naʻe ʻikai tenau ʻilo ha kolo ke nofo ai.
They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
Pea ʻi he fiekaia mo e fieinua, naʻe pongia ai honau laumālie ʻiate kinautolu.
Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
Pea naʻa nau toki tangi kia Sihova ʻi heʻenau tuʻutāmaki, pea ne ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu mei heʻenau ngaahi mamahi.
Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
Pea naʻa ne tataki atu ʻakinautolu ʻi he hala totonu, koeʻuhi kenau hoko ki he kolo naʻe kakai.
And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
Taumaiā ke fakamālō ʻae kakai kia Sihova koeʻuhi ko ʻene ʻaloʻofa, pea koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ki he fānau ʻae tangata!
Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
He ʻoku ne fakamākona ʻae laumālie ʻoku holi, mo ne fakapito ʻaki ʻae lelei ʻae laumālie ʻoku fiekaia.
For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
Ko kinautolu ʻoku nofo ʻi he fakapoʻuli pea mo e ʻata ʻae mate, kuo haʻi ʻaki ʻae mamahi mo e ukamea;
Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
Koeʻuhi naʻa nau angatuʻu ki he ngaahi folofola ʻae ʻOtua, mo nau fehiʻa ki he akonaki ʻae fungani Māʻolunga:
Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
Ko ia naʻa ne fakavaivaiʻi honau loto ʻi he ngāue; naʻa nau tō ki lalo, pea naʻe ʻikai ha taha ke tokoni.
Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
Pea naʻa nau toki tangi kia Sihova ʻi heʻenau tuʻutāmaki, pea ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu mei heʻenau ngaahi mamahi.
Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
Naʻa ne ʻomi ʻakinautolu mei he fakapoʻuli mo e ʻata ʻoe mate, ʻo ne motuhi honau ngaahi haʻi.
He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
Taumaiā ke fakamālō ʻae kakai kia Sihova koeʻuhi ko ʻene ʻaloʻofa, pea koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ki he fānau ʻae tangata!
Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
He kuo ne maumauʻi ʻae ngaahi matapā palasa, pea ne tutuʻu ʻae ngaahi ukamea fakamaʻu.
For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
‌ʻOku mamahi ʻae kau vale koeʻuhi ko ʻenau talangataʻa, pea mo ʻenau ngaahi hia.
Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
‌ʻOku fehiʻa honau laumālie ki he meʻakai kotoa pē; pea ʻoku nau fakaʻaʻau ki he ngaahi matapā ʻoe mate.
Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
Pea ʻoku nau toki tangi kia Sihova ʻi heʻenau tuʻutāmaki, pea ʻoku ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu mei heʻenau ngaahi mamahi.
Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
Naʻa ne fekau ʻene folofola, pea ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu, mo ne fakahaofi ʻakinautolu mei heʻenau ngaahi meʻa fakaʻauha.
He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
Taumaiā ke fakamālō ʻae kakai kia Sihova koeʻuhi ko ʻene ʻaloʻofa, pea koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ki he fānau ʻae tangata!
Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
Pea tuku kenau feilaulau ʻaki ʻae ngaahi feilaulau ʻoe fakafetaʻi, mo fakahā ʻene ngaahi ngāue ʻi he fiefia.
And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
Ko kinautolu ʻoku ʻalu hifo ki he tahi ʻi he ngaahi vaka, mo fai ʻae ngāue ʻi he ngaahi vai lahi;
They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
‌ʻOku nau mamata ki he ngaahi ngāue ʻa Sihova, mo ʻene ngaahi meʻa fakaofo ʻi he moana.
These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
He ʻoku fekau ʻe ia, pea ʻoku fakatupu ʻae matangi mālohi, ʻaia ʻoku tupu hake ai hono ngaahi peau.
For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
‌ʻOku nau ʻalu hake ki he langi, ʻoku nau toe ʻalu hifo ki he ngaahi loloto: kuo vela ʻo vai honau laumālie koeʻuhi ko e mamahi.
They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
‌ʻOku nau tasipa, pea luelue ʻo hangē ko e tangata konā, pea kuo mole honau poto kotoa pē.
They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit’s end.
‌ʻOku nau toki tangi kia Sihova ʻi heʻenau tuʻutāmaki, pea ʻoku ne ʻomi ʻakinautolu mei heʻenau ngaahi mamahi.
Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
‌ʻOku ne ngaohi ʻae afā ke tofukī, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai ngaue ai hono peau.
He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
Pea ʻoku nau toki fiefia koeʻuhi ʻoku nau fiemālie ai; pea ʻoku ne ʻomi ʻakinautolu ki he taulanga kuo nau holi ki ai.
Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
Taumaiā ke fakamālō ʻae kakai kia Sihova koeʻuhi ko ʻene ʻaloʻofa, pea koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ki he fānau ʻae tangata!
Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
Tuku kenau fakahikihiki ʻa ʻene ʻafio ʻi he fakataha ʻoe kakai, mo fakamālō
Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
‌ʻOku liliu ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi vaitafe ko e toafa, mo e ngaahi matavai ko e kelekele mōmoa;
He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
Mo e fonua mahu ko e hongea, koeʻuhi ko e angakovi ʻae kakai ʻoku nofo ai.
A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
‌ʻOku ne liliu ʻae toafa ko e ano vai, mo e fonua mōmoa ko e ngaahi matavai.
He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
Pea ʻoku ne pule ke nofo ai ʻae fiekaia, koeʻuhi kenau teuteu ʻae kolo ke nofo ai;
And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
Mo tūtuuʻi ʻae ngaahi ngoue, pea tō ʻae ngaahi ngoue vaine, ʻaia ʻoku faʻa ʻomi ʻae ngaahi fua kuo tupu.
And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
‌ʻOku ne fakamonūʻia foki ʻakinautolu, ko ia kuo nau tupu ʻo tokolahi ʻaupito; pea ʻoku ʻikai te ne tuku ke fakaʻaʻau ke siʻi ʻenau fanga manu.
He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
Pea ʻoku toe fakaʻaʻau ke tokosiʻi mo vaivai ʻakinautolu ʻi he fakamālohi, mo e mahaki, mo e mamahi.
Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
‌ʻOku ne lilingi ʻae manuki ki he ngaahi ʻeiki, pea ʻoku ne pule kenau ʻalu fano ʻi he toafa, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai ha hala ʻi ai.
He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
Ka ʻoku ne hiki hake ʻae masiva mei he mamahi, pea ʻoku ne ngaohi maʻana ʻae ngaahi kāinga ʻo hangē ko e fanga sipi.
Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
‌ʻE mamata ki ai ʻae angatonu, pea fiefia; pea ʻe tāpuni ʻe he angahala kotoa pē hono ngutu.
The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
Ko hai ʻoku poto, pea tokanga ki he ngaahi meʻa ni, tenau ʻiloʻi ʻae ʻaloʻofa ongongofua ʻa Sihova.
Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
‌ʻE ʻOtua, kuo maʻu hoku loto; te u hiva mo ʻatu ʻae fakamālō ʻaki hoku nāunau.
O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
Ke ʻā hake ʻae saliteli mo e haʻape: te u ʻa hengihengi hake pe au.
Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
‌ʻE Sihova, te u fakamālō kiate koe ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai: pea te u hiva fakamālō kiate koe ʻi he ngaahi puleʻanga.
I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
He ʻoku lahi hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ʻo māʻolunga hake ʻi he ngaahi langi: mo hoʻo moʻoni ʻoku aʻu atu ki he ngaahi ʻao.
For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
‌ʻE ʻOtua, ke māʻolunga lahi hake koe ʻi he ngaahi langi: pea ke māʻolunga hake ho nāunau ʻi māmani kotoa pē;
Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
Koeʻuhi ke hao ʻaia ʻoku ke ʻofa ai ke ke fakamoʻui ʻaki ho nima toʻomataʻu, ʻo talia au.
That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
Kuo folofola ʻae ʻOtua ʻi heʻene māʻoniʻoni; te u fiefia, “Te u vaeua ʻa Sikemi, ʻo fuofua ʻae luo ʻo Sukote.
God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
‌ʻOku ʻoʻoku ʻa Kiliati; ʻoku ʻoʻoku mo Manase; ko hono mālohi foki ʻo hoku ʻulu ʻa ʻIfalemi; ko ʻeku fai fono ʻa Siuta.
Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
Ko ʻeku ipu kaukauʻanga ʻa Moape; te u lī hoku topuvaʻe ki ʻolunga ki ʻItomi; te u vikiviki koeʻuhi ko Filisitia.”
Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
Ko hai te ne ʻomi au ki he kolo mālohi? Ko hai te ne aʻutaki au ki ʻItomi?
Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻe ʻikai, te ke fai ia, ʻa koe kuo ke liʻaki ʻakimautolu? Pea ʻikai te ke ʻalu atu, ʻE ʻOtua, mo ʻemau ngaahi kautau?
Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
Ke ke tuku kiate kimautolu ʻae tokoni ʻi he mamahi: he ʻoku taʻeʻaonga ʻae tokoni ʻae tangata.
Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
Ko e meʻa ʻi he ʻOtua te tau fai mālohi ai: he ko ia ia te ne malaki hifo hotau ngaahi fili.
Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
‌ʻE ʻOtua ʻo ʻeku fakamālō, ʻoua naʻa ke fakalongo pē;
Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
He kuo mafaʻa ʻae ngutu ʻoe angahala mo e ngutu ʻoe kākā kiate au: kuo nau lea kovi kiate au ʻaki ʻae ʻelelo loi.
For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
Naʻa nau kāpui foki au ʻaki ʻae ngaahi lea ʻoe taufehiʻa; mo nau tauʻi au taʻehanoʻuhinga.
They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
Ko e meʻa ʻi heʻeku ʻofa kuo hoko ʻakinautolu ko hoku ngaahi fili: ka te u hangahanga lotu pe au.
For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
Pea kuo nau totongi ʻaki kiate au ʻae kovi ki he lelei, mo e fehiʻa ki heʻeku ʻofa.
And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
Ke ke fakanofo ʻae tangata angakovi ke pule kiate ia: pea tuku ke tuʻu ʻa Sētane ʻi hono nima toʻomataʻu.
Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
‌ʻOka fakamaau ia, tuku ke halaia ia pea tuku ke hoko ʻene lotu ko e angahala.
When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
Tuku ke siʻi pē hono ngaahi ʻaho; pea ke maʻu ʻe ha taha kehe ʻene ngāue.
Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
Tuku ke tamai mate ʻene fānau, pea hoko ʻa hono uaifi ko e fefine kuo mate hono husepāniti.
Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
Tuku ke ne maʻuaipē ʻene fānau, mo kole: pea tuku kenau kumi foki ʻenau mā mei honau ngaahi potu ʻoku lala.
Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
Tuku ke maʻu ʻe he fakamālohi ʻae meʻa kotoa pē ʻoku ʻaʻana; pea maumauʻi ʻe he kau muli ʻene ngāue.
Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
‌ʻOua naʻa tuku ha taha ke manavaʻofa kiate ia: pea ʻoua naʻa tuku ha taha ke ʻofa ki heʻene fānau ʻoku tamai mate.
Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
Tuku ke tuʻusi hono hako; pea ʻi he toʻutangata ʻe haʻu tuku ke tāmateʻi honau hingoa.
Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
Ke manatuʻi ʻe Sihova ʻae hia ʻa ʻene ngaahi tamai; pea ʻoua naʻa tāmateʻi ʻae angahala ʻa ʻene faʻē.
Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
Tuku maʻuaipē ia ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, koeʻuhi ke ne tuʻusi honau fakamanatuʻi mei māmani.
Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
Koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai manatuʻi ʻe ia ke fakahā ʻae ʻofa, ka naʻa ne fakatanga ʻae tangata masiva mo paea, koeʻuhi ke ne tāmateʻi ʻaia ʻoku mafesi hono loto.
Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
Ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene ʻofa ki he kapekape, ko ia ke hoko ia kiate ia: ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene taʻefiefia ʻi he tāpuaki, ko ia ke mamaʻo ia ʻiate ia.
As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
Ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene fakakofuʻaki ia ʻae kape ʻo hangē ko e kofu, ko ia ke hoko ia ki hono kete ʻo hangē ko e vai, pea hangē ko e lolo ki hono ngaahi hui.
As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
Ke tatau ia kiate ia mo e kofu ʻaia ʻoku ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ia, pea mo e noʻo ʻaia ʻoku nonoʻo ʻaki maʻuaipē ia.
Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
Tuku eni ko e totongi ki hoku ngaahi fili meia Sihova, pea kiate kinautolu ʻoku nau lea ʻaki ʻae kovi ki hoku laumālie.
Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
Ka ke fai ʻe koe maʻaku, ʻE Sihova ko e ʻEiki, koeʻuhi ko ho huafa: koeʻuhi ʻoku lelei hoʻo ʻaloʻofa, ke ke fakamoʻui au.
But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
He ʻoku ou masiva mo paea, pea kuo lavea hoku loto ʻiate au.
For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
Kuo u mole atu ʻo hangē ko e ʻata ʻoka fakaʻaʻau ke ʻosi ia: kuo feʻaveʻaki au ʻo hangē ko e fanga heʻe.
I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
‌ʻOku vaivai hoku tui ʻi he ʻaukai: pea kuo mole ʻae sino ʻo hoku kakano.
My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
Ne u hoko foki ko e manukiʻanga kiate kinautolu: ʻi heʻenau sio mai kiate au, naʻa nau kalokalo honau ʻulu.
I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
Tokoniʻi au, ʻE Sihova ko hoku ʻOtua: ke ke fakamoʻui au ʻo hangē ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa:
Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
Koeʻuhi ke nau ʻilo ko ho nima eni; pea ko koe, ʻE Sihova, kuo ke fai ia.
That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.
Tuku kenau kape, ka ke fakamonūʻia ʻe koe: ʻoka nau ka tuʻu hake, tuku ke nau mā; kae tuku ke fiefia ʻa hoʻo tamaioʻeiki.
Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
Tuku ke kofu ʻa hoku ngaahi fili ʻaki ʻae mā, pea tuku kenau ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ʻakinautolu ʻa ʻenau puputuʻu, ʻo hangē ko e pulupulu.
Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
Te u fakamālō lahi kia Sihova ʻaki hoku ngutu; ʻio, te u fakamālō kiate ia ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe tokolahi.
I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
Koeʻuhi ʻe tuʻu ia ʻi he nima toʻomataʻu ʻoe masiva, ke fakamoʻui ia meiate kinautolu ʻoku nau fakahalaia hono laumālie.
For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
Naʻe pehē ʻE Sihova ki hoku ʻEiki, “Nofo koe ki hoku nima toʻomataʻu, kaeʻoua ke u ngaohi ho ngaahi fili ko ho tuʻungavaʻe.”
The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
‌ʻE fekau ʻe Sihova ʻae tokotoko ʻo ho mālohi mei Saione: “Ke ke pule ʻi he lotolotonga ʻo ho ngaahi fili.”
The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
‌ʻE loto matala ʻa hoʻo kakai ʻi he ʻaho ʻo ho mālohi, ʻi he ngaahi teunga matamatalelei ʻoe māʻoniʻoni mei he manāva ʻoe pongipongi: ʻoku ʻiate koe ʻae hahau ʻo hoʻo talavou.
Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
Kuo fuakava ʻa Sihova, pea ʻe ʻikai liliu ia, “Ko e taulaʻeiki koe ʻo lauikuonga ʻi he lakanga ʻo Melikiseteke.”
The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
Ko e ʻEiki ʻaia ʻoku ʻi ho nima toʻomataʻu, te ne taaʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi ʻi he ʻaho ʻo hono houhau.
The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
Te ne fakamaau ʻi he ʻao ʻoe hiteni, te ne fakapito ʻae ngaahi potu ʻaki ʻae ngaahi ʻangaʻanga; ʻe lavea ʻiate ia ʻae ʻulu ʻoe ngaahi fonua lahi.
He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
‌ʻE inu ia ʻi he vaitafe ʻi he hala: ko ia te ne hiki hake ai ʻae ʻulu.
He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
Mou fakamālō kia Sihova. Te u fakamālō kia Sihova ʻaki hoku loto kotoa pē, ʻi he fakataha ʻoe angatonu, pea ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe kakai.
Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
‌ʻOku lahi ʻae ngāue ʻa Sihova, ʻoku kumi ki ai ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku fiefia ai.
The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
‌ʻOku ongoongolelei mo nāunauʻia ʻa ʻene ngāue: pea ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene māʻoniʻoni.
His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
Kuo ne fai ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ke manatu ia ʻe he kakai: ʻoku manavaʻofa ʻa Sihova, pea fonu ʻi he ʻaloʻofa.
He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
Kuo foaki ʻe ia ʻae meʻakai kiate kinautolu ʻoku nau manavahē kiate ia: te ne manatuʻi maʻuaipē ʻa ʻene fuakava.
He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
Kuo ne fakahā ki hono kakai ʻae mālohi ʻo ʻene ngaahi ngāue, koeʻuhi ke ne foaki kiate kinautolu ʻae tofiʻa ʻoe hiteni.
He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
Ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻa hono nima ko e moʻoni mo e fakamaau: ʻoku moʻoni ʻa ʻene ngaahi fekau kotoa pē.
The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
‌ʻOku tuʻumaʻu ia ʻo lauikuonga pea taʻengata, pea kuo fai ia ʻi he moʻoni mo e angatonu.
They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
Naʻa ne fekau atu ʻae huhuʻi ki hono kakai: kuo ne fokotuʻu ʻene fuakava ʻo lauikuonga: ʻoku māʻoniʻoni mo ngeia ʻa hono huafa.
He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
Ko e manavahē kia Sihova ko e kamataʻanga ia ʻoe poto: ʻoku poto ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku fai ki heʻene fekau: ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻae fakamālō kiate ia.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
Mou fakamālō kia Sihova. ʻOku monūʻia ʻae tangata ʻoku ne manavahē kia Sihova, mo ne fiefia lahi ʻi heʻene ngaahi fekau.
Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
‌ʻE mālohi hono hako ʻi māmani: ko e toʻutangata ʻoe angatonu tenau monūʻia.
His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
‌ʻE ʻi hono fale ʻae koloa mo e nāunau: pea ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene angatonu.
Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
‌ʻOku tupu ʻae maama ki he angatonu ʻi he poʻuli: ʻoku angaʻofa ia, pea fonu ʻi he manavaʻofa, pea māʻoniʻoni.
Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
‌ʻOku fakahā ʻe he tangata angalelei ʻae ʻofa, pea ʻoku faʻa ʻatu: te ne pule ki heʻene meʻa ʻi he poto.
A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
Ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻikai ueʻi ia ʻo lauikuonga: ʻe taʻengata ʻae fakamanatu ki he kakai māʻoniʻoni.
Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
‌ʻE ʻikai te ne manavahē ki he ongoongo kovi: kuo maʻu hono loto ʻi he falala kia Sihova.
He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
Kuo fokotuʻumaʻu ʻa hono loto: ʻe ʻikai te ne manavahē, ka ʻe mamata ia ki hono ngaahi fili.
His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
Kuo tufa ʻe ia, kuo ne foaki ki he masiva; ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene angatonu; ʻe hiki hake hono nifo ʻi he ongolelei.
He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
‌ʻE mamata ki ai ʻae angahala, pea tenau mamahi: ʻe fengaiʻitaki hono nifo, pea ʻe mole atu ia: ʻe ʻauha ʻae holi ʻae angahala.
The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
Mou fakamālō kia Sihova. Fakamālō, ʻakimoutolu ko e kau tamaioʻeiki ʻa Sihova, fakamālō ki he huafa ʻo Sihova.
Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
Fakafetaʻi ki he huafa ʻo Sihova mei he ʻaho ni ʻo taʻengata.
Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
Ke fakamālō ki he huafa ʻo Sihova, mei he hopo hake ʻoe laʻā ʻo aʻu ki heʻene tō hifo.
From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’s name is to be praised.
‌ʻOku māʻolunga hake ʻa Sihova ʻi he ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pē, mo hono nāunau ʻoku māʻolunga hake ʻi he ngaahi langi.
The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
Ko hai ʻoku na tatau mo Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua, ʻaia ʻoku ʻafio ʻi ʻolunga,
Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
‌ʻOku ne fakamoʻulaloaʻi ia ke ʻafio ki he ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ʻi he langi, pea mo māmani!
Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
‌ʻOku ne fokotuʻu hake ʻae masiva mei he efu, mo ne hiki hake ʻae paea mei he tuʻunga ʻotoʻota;
He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
Koeʻuhi ke ne fakataha mo e ngaahi ʻeiki, pea ke kautaha mo e houʻeiki ʻo hono kakai.
That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
‌ʻOku ne ngaohi ʻae fefine paʻa ke tauhi ʻae fale, pea ke hoko ʻi he fiefia ko e faʻē ʻae fānau. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
‌ʻI he ʻalu atu ʻa ʻIsileli mei ʻIsipite, ko e fale ʻo Sēkope mei he kakai ʻoe lea kehe;
When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
Ko hono faletapu ʻa Siuta, mo hono puleʻanga ʻa ʻIsileli.
Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
Naʻe mamata ki ai ʻae tahi, pea hola ai: naʻe tekeʻi atu ʻo fakaholomui ʻa Sioatani.
The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
Naʻe hopohopo ʻae ngaahi moʻunga ʻo hangē ko e fanga sipitangata, mo e ngaahi foʻi moʻunga ʻo hangē ko e fanga lami.
The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
Ko e hā naʻe hoko kiate koe, ʻa koe ko e tahi, koeʻuhi naʻa ke hola ai? ʻA koe Sioatani, koeʻuhi ke tekeʻi atu ʻo fakaholomui koe?
What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
‌ʻAe ngaahi moʻunga, koeʻuhi naʻa mou hopohopo ai ʻo hangē ko e fanga sipitangata; mo kimoutolu ʻae ngaahi foʻi moʻunga, ʻo hangē ko e fanga lami?
Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
‌ʻA koe ko māmani, ke ke tetetete ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻEiki, ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope;
Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
‌ʻAia naʻa ne liliu ʻae maka ko e anovai, mo e maka afi ko e matavai.
Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
‌ʻOua naʻa tuku kiate kimautolu, ʻE Sihova, ʻoua naʻa tuku kiate kimautolu, ka ki ho huafa ʻae ongoongolelei, koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa, pea mo hoʻo moʻoni.
Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake.
Ko e hā ʻe pehē ai ʻe he hiteni, “Ko e fē honau ʻOtua?”
Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
Ka ko hotau ʻOtua ʻoku ʻi he ngaahi langi: kuo ne fai ʻaia kuo ne finangalo ki ai.
But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
Ko honau ngaahi tamapua ko e siliva mo e koula, ko e ngāue ʻae nima ʻoe tangata.
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
‌ʻOku ai honau ngutu, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau lea: ʻoku nau maʻu ʻae mata, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau mamata:
They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
‌ʻOku nau telinga, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau ongoʻi: ʻoku ai honau ihu, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau nanamu:
They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
‌ʻOku nau maʻu ʻae nima, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau ala ki ha meʻa: ʻoku ai honau vaʻe, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau ʻaʻeva: pea ʻoku ʻikai tenau lea ʻaki honau kia.
They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
Ko kinautolu ʻoku ngaohi ʻakinautolu ʻoku nau tatau mo kinautolu: pea ʻoku pehē pe ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku falala ki ai.
They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
‌ʻE ʻIsileli, ke ke falala kia Sihova ko honau tokoni ia mo honau fakaū.
O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
‌ʻE fale ʻo ʻElone, ke ke falala kia Sihova: ko honau tokoni ia mo honau fakaū.
O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
‌ʻAkimoutolu ʻoku manavahē kia Sihova, mou falala kia Sihova: ko honau tokoni ia mo honau fakaū.
Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
Kuo manatuʻi ʻe Sihova ʻakitautolu: te ne tāpuaki ʻakitautolu; te ne tāpuaki ʻae fale ʻo ʻIsileli; te ne tāpuaki ʻae fale ʻo ʻElone.
The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
Te ne tāpuaki ʻakinautolu ʻoku nau manavahē kia Sihova, ʻae iiki mo e lalahi.
He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.
‌ʻE fakatokolahi ʻakimoutolu ʻe Sihova, pea te mou tupu pe, ʻakimoutolu mo hoʻomou fānau.
The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
‌ʻOku mou monūʻia ʻia Sihova, ʻaia naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae langi mo māmani.
Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
‌ʻOku ʻo Sihova ʻae langi, ʻio, ko e ngaahi langi: pea kuo ne foaki ʻa māmani ki he fānau ʻae tangata.
The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD’s: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
‌ʻOku ʻikai fakamālō kia Sihova ʻae mate, pe ha taha ʻoku ʻalu hifo ki he fakalongo pē.
The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.
Ka te tau fakafetaʻi kia Sihova mei he ʻaho ni ʻo taʻengata. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.
‌ʻOku ou ʻofa kia Sihova, koeʻuhi kuo ne ongoʻi hoku leʻo mo ʻeku lotu tāumaʻu.
I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
Koeʻuhi kuo ne fakatokangaʻi hono fofonga kiate au, ko ia te u ui ai ki heʻene ʻafio ʻi hoku ngaahi ʻaho.
Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
Naʻe kāpui au ʻe he ngaahi mamahi ʻoe mate, pea naʻe puke au ʻe he ngaahi mamahi ʻo heli: naʻaku ʻilo ai ʻae tuʻutāmaki mo e mamahi.
The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
Pea naʻaku toki ui ki he huafa ʻo Sihova; “ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke fakamoʻui hoku laumālie.”
Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
‌ʻOku manavaʻofa ʻa Sihova, mo māʻoniʻoni; ʻio, ʻoku ʻaloʻofa ʻa hotau ʻOtua.
Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
‌ʻOku fakamoʻui ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae taʻekākā: naʻaku vaivai pea naʻa ne tokoniʻi au.
The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
‌ʻE hoku laumālie, ke ke foki ki ho mālōlōʻanga; he kuo lahi ʻae foaki ʻa Sihova kiate koe.
Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
He kuo ke fakamoʻui hoku laumālie mei he mate, mo hoku mata mei he loʻimata, mo hoku vaʻe ke ʻoua naʻa hinga.
For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
Te u ʻeveʻeva, ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova ʻi he fonua ʻoe moʻui.
I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
Naʻaku tui, ko ia kuo u lea ai: “Naʻaku mahaki lahi:”
I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
Naʻaku pehē ʻi heʻeku toʻotoʻo, “ʻOku loi ʻae kakai kotoa pē.”
I said in my haste, All men are liars.
Ko e hā te u ʻatu kia Sihova koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi meʻaʻofa kotoa pē kiate au?
What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
Te u toʻo ʻae ipu ʻoe fakamoʻui, pea te u ui ki he huafa ʻo Sihova.
I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
Te u fai ni ʻeku ngaahi fuakava kia Sihova ʻi he ʻao ʻo hono kakai kotoa pē.
I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
‌ʻOku mahuʻinga ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova ʻae pekia ʻo ʻene kakai māʻoniʻoni.
Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
‌ʻE Sihova, ko e moʻoni ko hoʻo tamaioʻeiki au; ko hoʻo tamaioʻeiki au, mo e tama ʻa hoʻo kaunanga: kuo ke vete hoku ngaahi haʻi.
O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
Te u ʻatu kiate koe ʻae feilaulau ʻoe fakafetaʻi, pea ui ki he huafa ʻo Sihova.
I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
Te u fai ni ʻeku ngaahi fuakava kia Sihova ʻi he ʻao ʻo hono kakai kotoa pē,
I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,
‌ʻI he ngaahi lotoʻā ʻoe fale ʻo Sihova, ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoʻou, ʻE Selūsalema. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
In the courts of the LORD’s house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
Mou fakamālō kia Sihova, ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pē: fakamālō ki heʻene ʻafio, ʻakimoutolu ʻae kakai kotoa pē.
O Praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
He ʻoku lahi ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa kiate kitautolu: pea ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻae moʻoni ʻa Sihova. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova he ʻoku angalelei ia: koeʻuhi ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
Ke lea ni ʻe ʻIsileli, “ʻOku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.”
Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
Ke lea ni ʻae fale ʻo ʻElone, “ʻOku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.”
Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
Tuku ke lea ni ʻakinautolu ʻoku nau manavahē kia Sihova, ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
Naʻaku ui kia Sihova ʻi he mamahi: pea naʻe talia au ʻe Sihova, mo ne tuku au ki he potu ʻataʻatā.
I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.
‌ʻOku kau maʻaku ʻa Sihova; ʻe ʻikai te u manavahē ko e hā ʻe faʻa fai ʻe he tangata kiate au.
The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
‌ʻOku fai maʻaku ʻa Sihova mo kinautolu ʻoku nau tokoni au: ko ia te u mamata ai kiate kinautolu ʻoku nau fehiʻa kiate au.
The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
‌ʻOku lelei lahi ʻae falala kia Sihova ʻi he falala ki he tangata.
It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
‌ʻOku lelei lahi ʻae falala kia Sihova ʻi he falala ki he ngaahi ʻeiki.
It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
Naʻe kāpui au ʻe he ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pē: ka ʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova te u fakaʻauha ʻakinautolu.
All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
Naʻa nau takatakai au; ʻio, naʻa nau kāpui au: ka ʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova te u fakaʻauha ʻakinautolu.
They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
Naʻa nau kāpui au ʻo hangē ko e fanga pi; kuo tāmateʻi ʻakinautolu ʻo hangē ko e afi ʻi he ʻakau talatala: he te u fakaʻauha ʻakinautolu ʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova.
They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
Kuo ke tekeʻi mālohi au koeʻuhi ke u hinga ai: ka naʻe tokoni au ʻe Sihova
Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
Ko hoku mālohi ʻa Sihova mo ʻeku hiva, pea kuo hoko ia ko hoku fakamoʻui.
The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
Ko e lea ʻoe fiefia mo e fakamoʻui ʻoku ʻi he ngaahi fale fehikitaki ʻoe angatonu: ʻoku fai mālohi ʻae nima toʻomataʻu ʻo Sihova.
The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
Kuo hiki hake ʻae nima toʻomataʻu ʻo Sihova: ʻoku fai mālohi ʻae nima toʻomataʻu ʻo Sihova.
The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
‌ʻE ʻikai te u mate, kae moʻui, ʻo fakahā ʻae ngaahi ngāue ʻa Sihova.
I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
Kuo tautea fakamamahiʻi au ʻe Sihova: ka ʻoku teʻeki ai te ne tukuange au ki he mate.
The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
Toʻo kiate au ʻae ngaahi matapā ʻoe māʻoniʻoni: te u hū ai, pea u fakamālō kia Sihova:
Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:
Ko e matapā eni ʻo Sihova, ʻaia ʻe hū ai ʻae angatonu.
This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
Te u fakamālō kiate koe: he kuo ke ongoʻi au, pea kuo ke hoko ko hoku fakamoʻui.
I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
Ko e maka naʻe liʻaki ʻe he kau tufunga kuo hoko ia ko e fungani maka ʻoe tuliki.
The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
Ko e ngāue eni ʻa Sihova; pea ko e meʻa fakaofo ʻi hotau ʻao.
This is the LORD’s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
Ko e ʻaho eni kuo ngaohi ʻe Sihova; te tau fiefia pea nekeneka ai.
This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke fakamoʻui ni: ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke tuku mai ni ʻae monūʻia.
Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
Ke monūʻia ia ʻoku haʻu ʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova: kuo mau tāpuekina ʻakimoutolu mei he fale ʻo Sihova.
Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.
Ko e ʻOtua ko Sihova ia, ʻaia kuo ne fakahā ʻae maama kiate kitautolu: mou nonoʻo ʻae feilaulau ʻaki ʻae ngaahi afo ki he ngaahi nifo, ʻoe feilaulauʻanga.
God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
Ko koe ko hoku ʻOtua, pea te u fakamālō kiate koe: ko koe ko hoku ʻOtua, te u fakahikihikiʻi koe.
