Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova he ʻoku angalelei ia: koeʻuhi ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻae haohaoa ʻi he hala, ʻaia ʻoku ʻeveʻeva ʻi he fono ʻa Sihova.
Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻakinautolu ʻoku tauhi ʻene ngaahi fakamoʻoni, pea kumi kiate ia ʻaki honau loto kotoa pē.
Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
‌ʻOku ʻikai foki tenau fai ha kovi: ʻoku nau ʻaʻeva ʻi hono ngaahi hala.
They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
Kuo ke fekau mai ke mau tauhi maʻu hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.
Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
‌ʻOku ʻamusiaange ʻeau kuo fakahinohino ki hoku ngaahi hala, ke fai ki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
Pea ʻe ʻikai te u mā, ʻo kau ka tokanga ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau kotoa pē.
Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
Te u fakamālō kiate koe ʻi he angatonu ʻoe loto, ʻo kau ka ʻilo hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau māʻoniʻoni.
I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
Te u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni: ʻoua naʻa ke siʻaki ʻaupito au.
I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
‌ʻE fakamaʻa ʻe he tangata talavou hono hala ʻi he hā? ʻI heʻene tokanga ki ai ʻo hangē ko hoʻo folofola.
Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
Kuo u kumi kiate koe ʻaki hoku loto kotoa pē: ʻoua naʻa tuku au ke u hē mei hoʻo ngaahi fekau.
With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
Kuo u fufū hoʻo folofola ʻi hoku loto, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻaku angahala kiate koe.
Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku monūʻia ʻa hoʻo ʻafio: ako kiate au hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
Kuo u fakahā ʻaki hoku loungutu, ʻae ngaahi fakamaau kotoa pē ʻa ho fofonga.
With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
Naʻaku fiefia ʻi hono ʻalunga ʻo hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni, ʻo tatau mo e ngaahi koloa kotoa pē.
I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
Te u fakalaulauloto ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki, pea te u tokanga ki ho ngaahi hala.
I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
Te u fakafiefiaʻi au ʻi hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni: ʻe ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo folofola.
I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
Foaki ke lahi ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki, koeʻuhi ke u moʻui, pea te u tauhi ki hoʻo folofola.
Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
Ke ke fakaʻā hoku mata, koeʻuhi ke u mamata ki he ngaahi meʻa fakaofo ʻi hoʻo fono.
Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
Ko e muli au ʻi māmani: ʻoua naʻa fufū hoʻo ngaahi fekau ʻiate au.
I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
‌ʻOku mafesi hoku laumālie koeʻuhi ko ʻene holi ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.
My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
Kuo ke valokiʻi ʻae laukau, ʻakinautolu ʻoku malaʻia, ʻaia kuo hē mei hoʻo ngaahi fekau.
Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
‌ʻAve ʻiate au ʻae taukaea mo e manukia; he kuo u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.
Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
Naʻe nofo foki ʻae ngaahi ʻeiki ʻo lauʻikoviʻi au: ka naʻe fakalauloto ʻa hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
Ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni foki ko hoku fiefiaʻanga ia, mo hoku ngaahi akonakiʻi.
Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
‌ʻOku pikitai ʻa hoku laumālie ki he efu: ke ke fakamoʻui au ʻo hangē ko hoʻo folofola.
My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
Kuo u fakahā hoku ngaahi hala, pea naʻa ke ongoʻi au: ako kiate au hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
Ngaohi au ke u ʻilo ʻae hala ʻo hoʻo ngaahi akonaki: pea te u lea ki hoʻo ngaahi ngāue fakaofo.
Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
Kuo vai ʻa hoku laumālie koeʻuhi ko e ongosia: fakamālohiʻi au ʻo hangē ko hoʻo folofola.
My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
Ke ke hiki ʻiate au ʻae hala ʻoe loi, pea ke tuku mai hoʻo fono kiate au ʻi he ʻofa.
Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
Kuo u fili ʻae hala ʻoe moʻoni: pea kuo u fokotuʻu hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau ʻi hoku ʻao.
I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
Kuo u pikitai ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni; ʻE Sihova, ʻoua naʻa ke fakamaaʻi au.
I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
Te u lele ʻi he hala ʻo hoʻo ngaahi fekau, ʻoka ke ka fakaʻataʻatā hoku loto.
I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
‌ʻE Sihova, ke ke ako kiate au ʻae hala ʻo hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni; pea te u fai ki ai ʻo aʻu ki he ngataʻanga.
Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
Foaki mai kiate au ʻae faʻa ʻilo, pea te u fai ki hoʻo fono; ʻio, te u tokanga ki ai ʻaki hoku loto kotoa pē.
Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
Ngaohi au ke u ʻalu ʻi he hala ʻo hoʻo ngaahi fekau; he ʻoku ou fiefia ai.
Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
Fakatokangaʻi hoku loto ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni, kae ʻikai ki he manumanu.
Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
Taʻofi hoku mata mei he vakai ki he meʻa vaʻinga; pea ke fakaakeake au ʻi ho hala.
Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
Fakamoʻoni hoʻo folofola ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki, ʻaia ʻoku fakaʻapaʻapa kiate koe.
Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
Taʻofi atu hoku manukia ʻaia ʻoku ou manavahē ai: he ʻoku lelei hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.
Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
Vakai, ʻoku ou holi ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki: fakamoʻui au ʻi ho māʻoniʻoni.
Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
‌ʻE Sihova, tuku ke hoko foki hoʻo ngaahi ʻaloʻofa kiate au, ʻio, ko hoʻo fakamoʻui, ʻo hangē ko hoʻo folofola.
Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
Pehē te u maʻu ha meʻa ke tali ʻaki kiate ia ʻoku manukiʻi au: he ʻoku ou falala ki hoʻo folofola.
So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
Pea ʻoua naʻa toʻo ʻaupito ʻae folofola ʻoe moʻoni mei hoku ngutu; he kuo u ʻamanaki lelei ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.
And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
Pea te u fai maʻuaipē ki hoʻo fono ʻo lauikuonga pea taʻengata.
So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
Pea te u ʻeveʻeva ʻi he tauʻatāina: he ʻoku ou kumi ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.
And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
Te u lea foki ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ngaahi tuʻi, pea ʻe ʻikai te u mā ai.
I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
Pea te u fakafiefiaʻi au ʻi hoʻo ngaahi fekau, ʻaia kuo u ʻofa ki ai.
And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
Te u hiki hake foki hoku nima ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau, ʻaia kuo u ʻofa ki ai pea te u fakalaulauloto ki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
Manatuʻi ʻae folofola ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki, ʻaia kuo ke fakaʻamanakiʻi au ki ai.
Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
Ko hoku fiemālieʻanga eni ʻi heʻeku mamahi: he ko hoʻo folofola kuo ne fakamoʻui au.
This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
Kuo manuki lahi kiate au ʻae laukau: ka naʻe ʻikai te u afe mei hoʻo fono.
The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
‌ʻE Sihova, naʻaku manatu ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau ʻi muʻa; pea u fakafiemālieʻi au.
I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
Kuo pukea au ʻe he ilifia koeʻuhi ko e angahala kuo nau siʻaki hoʻo fono.
Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
Ko hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni ko ʻeku hiva ia ʻi he fale ʻo ʻeku ʻāunofo.
Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
‌ʻE Sihova, kuo u manatu ki ho huafa ʻi he pō, pea u fai ki hoʻo fono.
I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
Naʻaku maʻu eni, ko e meʻa ʻi heʻeku fai ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.
This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
‌ʻE Sihova, ko hoku ʻinasi ʻa koe: naʻaku pehē te u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi folofola.
Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
Naʻaku kole ki hoʻo ʻofa ʻaki hoku loto kotoa pē: ke ke ʻaloʻofa mai kiate au ʻo hangē ko hoʻo folofola.
I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
Naʻaku fifili ki hoku ngaahi ʻaluʻanga, pea u fakaafe hoku vaʻe ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.
I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
Ne u fakatoʻotoʻo, pea ʻikai tuai, ʻeku fai ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau.
I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
Kuo kaihaʻasia au ʻe he ngaahi kaihaʻakau ʻoe kau angahala: ka naʻe ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au ʻa hoʻo fono.
The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
Te u tuʻu hake ʻi he tuʻuapō mālie ke fakafetaʻi kiate koe, koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau māʻoniʻoni.
At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
‌ʻOku ou kaumeʻa mo kinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku manavahē kiate koe, mo kinautolu ʻoku fai ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau.
I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku fonu ʻa māmani ʻi hoʻo ʻaloʻofa: ke ke ako kiate au ʻa hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
‌ʻE Sihova, kuo ke fie fai lelei ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki, ʻo hangē ko hoʻo folofola.
Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
Ke ke ako kiate au ʻae fakamaau lelei mo e faʻa ʻilo: he ʻoku ou tui ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau.
Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
‌ʻI he teʻeki ai te u mahaki naʻaku hē: ka ko eni kuo u fai ki hoʻo folofola.
Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
‌ʻOku ke angalelei, pea ʻoku ke fai lelei; ke ke ako kiate au ʻa hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
Kuo fakatupu ʻe he fielahi ʻae loi kiate au: ka te u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki ʻaki hoku loto kotoa pē.
The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
‌ʻOku tatau honau loto mo e ngako, ka ʻoku ou fiefia ʻi hoʻo fono.
Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
Kuo ʻaonga kiate au ʻa hoku mahaki; koeʻuhi ke u ʻilo ai hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
‌ʻOku lelei lahi kiate au ʻae fono ʻaho fofonga ʻi he ngaahi afe ʻoe kuonga koula mo e siliva.
The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
Ko ho nima naʻa ne ngaohi au mo fakatonutonu: foaki mai ʻae poto, koeʻuhi ke u ʻiloʻi hoʻo ngaahi fekau.
Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
Ko kinautolu ʻoku manavahē kiate koe tenau fiefia ʻoka nau ka mamata kiate au; koeʻuhi naʻaku ʻamanaki ki hoʻo folofola.
They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou ʻilo ʻoku totonu hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau, pea ʻi he angatonu kuo ke fakamamahiʻi au.
I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
‌ʻOku ou kole kiate koe, tuku ke fakafiemālieʻi au ʻe hoʻo ʻaloʻofa, ʻo hangē ko hoʻo folofola ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki.
Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
Tuku ke hoko kiate au hoʻo ngaahi ʻaloʻofa ongongofua, koeʻuhi ke u moʻui ai: he ko hoʻo fono ko hoku fiefiaʻanga ia.
Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
Tuku ke mā ʻae fielahi; he naʻa Tuku ke tafoki mai kiate au ʻakinautolu ʻoku manavahē kiate koe, pea mo kinautolu kuo nau ʻiloʻi hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.
Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
Tuku ke tafoki mai kiate au ʻakinautolu ʻoku manavahē kiate koe, pea mo kinautolu kuo nau ʻiloʻi hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.
Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
Tuku ke haohaoa hoku loto ʻi hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni; koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻaku mā ai.
Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
‌ʻOku pongia hoku laumālie ʻi he fiemaʻu hoʻo fakamoʻui: ka ʻoku ou ʻamanaki ki hoʻo folofola.
My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
‌ʻOku vaivai hoku mata koeʻuhi ko hoʻo folofola, ʻoku ou pehē, “Te ke fakafiemālieʻi au ʻafē?”
Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
He kuo u hoko ʻo tatau mo e hina ʻi he ʻohuafi; ka ʻoku ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
‌ʻOku fiha ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ʻo hoʻo tamaioʻeiki? Te ke fakamaau ʻafē ʻakinautolu ʻoku fakatangaʻi au?
How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
Kuo keli ʻe he fielahi ʻae ngaahi luo kiate au ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai tatau mo hoʻo fono.
The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
‌ʻOku tuʻumaʻu hoʻo ngaahi fekau kotoa pē: ʻoku taʻetotonu ʻenau fakatangaʻi au; ke ke tokoniʻi au,
All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
Naʻa nau meimei fakaʻauha au ʻi māmani ka naʻe ʻikai te u siʻaki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.
They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
Fakamoʻui au ʻo hangē ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa; ko ia te u tauhi ai ʻae fakamoʻoni ʻa ho fofonga.
Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku tuʻumaʻu hoʻo folofola ʻi he langi ʻo lauikuonga.
For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
‌ʻOku aʻu atu hoʻo moʻoni ki he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē: kuo ke fokotuʻu ʻa māmani, pea ʻoku tuʻumaʻu ia.
Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
‌ʻOku nau tolonga he ʻaho ni ʻo hangē ko hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni: he ko hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki ʻae meʻa kotoa pē.
They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
Ka ne ʻikai ko hoku fiefiaʻanga ʻa hoʻo fono, pehē, ne u mate ʻi hoku mahaki.
Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
‌ʻE ʻikai siʻi ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo ngaahi akonaki ʻo lauikuonga: he ko ia kuo ke fakamoʻui ai au.
I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
‌ʻOku ʻaʻau au, ke ke fakamoʻui au he kuo u kumi ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.
I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
Kuo tatali ʻae angahala kiate au ke tāmateʻi au: ka te u fifili ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.
The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
Kuo u mamata ki hono ngataʻanga ʻoe haohaoa kotoa pē: ka ʻoku laulahi ʻaupito ʻa hoʻo fekau.
I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
‌ʻOku ou ʻofa lahi ki hoʻo fono: ʻoku ou fakalaulauloto ki ai ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.
O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
Kuo ke ngaohi au ʻi hoʻo ngaahi fekau ke u poto hake ʻi hoku ngaahi fili: he ʻoku ʻiate au maʻuaipē ia.
Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
‌ʻOku ou poto lahi hake ʻi heʻeku kau akonaki kotoa pē: he ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni ko hoku fakakaukauʻanga ia.
I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
‌ʻOku ou ʻilo lahi hake ʻi he kau mātuʻa, koeʻuhi ʻoku ou tauhi hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.
I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
Naʻaku taʻofi hoku vaʻe mei he hala kovi kotoa pē, koeʻuhi ke u fai ki hoʻo folofola.
I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
Naʻe ʻikai te u afe mei hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau: he kuo ke akonakiʻi au.
I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
‌ʻOku huʻamelie lahi hoʻo ngaahi folofola ki hoku ifo! ʻIo, ʻoku melie lahi ʻi he hone ki hoku ngutu!
How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
‌ʻOku ou maʻu ʻae poto ʻi hoʻo ngaahi akonaki: ko ia ʻoku ou fehiʻa ai ki he hala kotoa pē ʻoe loi.
Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
Ko hoʻo folofola ko e tūhulu ia ki hoku vaʻe, mo e maama ki hoku hala.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
Kuo u fuakava, pea te u fai ki ai, ke u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau māʻoniʻoni.
I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
‌ʻOku lahi ʻaupito hoku mahaki: fakamoʻui au, ʻE Sihova, ʻo hangē ko hoʻo folofola.
I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke maʻu ʻae ngaahi feilaulau loto lelei ʻa hoku ngutu, pea ke ako kiate au hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.
Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
‌ʻOku ʻi hoku nima maʻuaipē ʻa ʻeku moʻui: ka ʻoku ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo fono.
My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
Kuo ʻai ʻe he angahala ʻae tauhele kiate au: ka naʻe ʻikai te u hē mei hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.
The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
Kuo u maʻu ʻa hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni ko hoku tofiʻa ʻo lauikuonga: he ko e fiefiaʻanga ia ʻo hoku loto.
Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
Kuo u fakatokangaʻi hoku loto ke fai maʻuaipē ki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni, ʻo aʻu ki he ngataʻanga.
I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
‌ʻOku ou fehiʻa ki he ngaahi mahalo kovi: ka ʻoku ou ʻofa ki hoʻo fono.
I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
Ko koe ko hoku toitoiʻanga, mo hoku fakaū; ʻoku ou ʻamanaki lelei ʻi hoʻo folofola.
Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
‌ʻAlu ʻiate au, ʻakimoutolu ʻoku fai kovi: he te u fai ki he ngaahi fekau ʻa hoku ʻOtua.
Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
Poupou hake au ʻo hangē ko hoʻo folofola, koeʻuhi ke u moʻui ai. Pea ʻoua naʻa tuku au ke u mā ʻi heʻeku ʻamanaki.
Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Ke ke poupou hake au, pea te u hao ai: pea te u tokanga maʻuaipē ki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
Kuo ke malaki hifo ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku hē mei hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni: he ko ʻenau kākā ko e loi ia.
Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
‌ʻOku ke siʻaki ʻae kau angahala kotoa pē ʻo māmani ʻo hangē ko e ʻotoʻota: ko ia ʻoku ou ʻofa ai ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.
Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
‌ʻOku tetetete hoku kakano ko e meʻa ʻi heʻeku manavahē kiate koe; pea ʻoku ou manavahē ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.
My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
Kuo u fai ʻae fakamaau mo e angatonu: ʻoua naʻa tukuange au ki he kau fakamālohi kiate au.
I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
Ke ke hoko ko e ungakiʻi ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ke u lelei ai; ʻoua naʻa tuku ke taʻomia au ʻe he fielahi.
Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
‌ʻOku vaivai hoku mata koeʻuhi ko hoʻo fakamoʻui, pea mo e folofola ʻo hoʻo māʻoniʻoni.
Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
Fai ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ʻo hangē ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa, pea ke ako kiate au ʻa hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
Ko hoʻo tamaioʻeiki au; foaki mai ʻae poto, koeʻuhi ke u ʻilo ai hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.
I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
‌ʻE Sihova, kuo hoko ʻae kuonga ke ke ngāue ai: he kuo nau fakataʻeʻaongaʻi hoʻo fono.
It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
Ko ia ʻoku ou ʻofa lahi hake ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau ʻi he koula; ʻio, ʻi he koula lelei.
Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
Ko ia ʻoku ou pehē ʻoku totonu hoʻo ngaahi akonaki kotoa pē; pea ʻoku ou fehiʻa ki he hala kotoa pē ʻoe loi.
Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
‌ʻOku fakamanavahē hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni: ko ia ʻoku fai ki ai ʻa hoku laumālie.
Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
Ko e hū loto ʻa hoʻo ngaahi folofola ʻoku foaki ai ʻae maama; ʻoku ʻomi ʻe ia ʻae poto ki he taʻekākā.
The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
Ne u mafaʻa hoku ngutu, pea u holi he ʻoku ou feinga ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau.
I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
Ke ke ʻafio mai kiate au, mo ke ʻaloʻofa kiate au, ʻo hangē ko hoʻo faʻa fai kiate kinautolu ʻoku ʻofa ki ho huafa.
Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
Tuʻutuʻuni ʻeku ngaahi laka ʻi hoʻo folofola: pea ʻoua naʻa tuku ke pule kiate au ha hia ʻe taha.
Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
Fakamoʻui au mei he fakamālohi ʻae tangata: pea te u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.
Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
Tuku ke ulo mai ho fofonga ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki; pea ke ako kiate au hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
‌ʻOku tafe hifo ʻae ngaahi vaitafe ʻi hoku mata, koeʻuhi ʻoku ʻikai tenau tokanga ki hoʻo fono.
Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ke angatonu, pea ʻoku totonu hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.
Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
‌ʻOku māʻoniʻoni pea ʻoku tuʻumaʻu ʻaupito hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni, ʻaia kuo ke fekau mai.
Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
Kuo u ʻosiʻosiloto ʻi heʻeku fai feinga, koeʻuhi kuo ngalo ʻi hoku ngaahi fili hoʻo ngaahi folofola.
My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
‌ʻOku haohaoa ʻaupito hoʻo folofola: ko ia ʻoku ʻofa ki ai ʻa hoʻo tamaioʻeiki.
Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
‌ʻOku ou siʻi au mo manukia: ka ʻoku ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.
I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
Ko hoʻo māʻoniʻoni ko e māʻoniʻoni taʻengata, pea ko hoʻo fono ko e moʻoni ia.
Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
Kuo pukea au ʻe he mamahi mo e feinga: ka ko hoʻo ngaahi fekau ko hoku fiefiaʻanga ia.
Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
‌ʻOku taʻengata ʻae māʻoniʻoni ʻo hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni: ke ke foaki mai ʻae poto, pea te u moʻui ai.
The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
Naʻaku tangi ʻaki hoku loto kotoa; ke ke ongoʻi au, ʻE Sihova: te u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
Ne u tangi kiate koe; fakamoʻui au, koeʻuhi ke u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.
I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
Naʻaku muʻomuʻa ʻi he maʻa ʻae ʻaho, pea u tangi: ne u ʻamanaki ʻi hoʻo folofola.
I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
‌ʻOku muʻomuʻa ʻa hoku mata ki he ngaahi leʻo ʻoe pō, koeʻuhi ke u fakakaukau ki hoʻo folofola.
Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
Ke ke fanongo ki hoku leʻo ʻo hangē ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa: ʻE Sihova, fakamoʻui au ʻo hangē ko hoʻo fakamaau.
Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
‌ʻOku ʻunuʻunu mai ʻakinautolu ʻoku nau angimui ki he kovi: ʻoku nau mamaʻo mei hoʻo fono.
They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
‌ʻOku ke ofi mai, ʻE Sihova; pea ʻoku moʻoni hoʻo ngaahi fekau kotoa pē.
Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
Koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni, kuo fuoloa ʻeku ʻilo kuo ke fakamaau ia ʻo lauikuonga.
Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
Ke ke tokanga ki hoku mahaki, pea ke fakamoʻui au: he ʻoku ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo fono.
Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
Ke ke fakamatala ʻeku meʻa, mo fakahaofi au: fakamoʻui au ʻo hangē ko hoʻo folofola.
Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
‌ʻOku mamaʻo ʻae fakamoʻui mei he angahala: he ʻoku ʻikai tenau kumi ki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
‌ʻOku lahi hoʻo ngaahi ʻaloʻofa ongongofua, ʻE Sihova: fakamoʻui au ʻo hangē ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.
Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
‌ʻOku tokolahi hoku kau fakatanga mo hoku ngaahi fili; ka ʻoku ʻikai te u afe mei hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.
Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
Naʻaku mamata ki he kau talangataʻa, pea u mamahi ai; koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai tenau fai ki hoʻo folofola.
I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
Ke ke ʻafio ki hono anga ʻo ʻeku ʻofa ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki: fakamoʻui au, ʻE Sihova, ʻo hangē ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa.
Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
‌ʻOku moʻoni hoʻo folofola mei hono kamataʻanga: pea ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau māʻoniʻoni kotoa pē.
Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
Kuo fakatanga au taʻehanoʻuhinga ʻe he ngaahi ʻeiki: ka ʻoku fakaʻapaʻapa ʻa hoku loto ki hoʻo folofola.
Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
‌ʻOku ou fiefia ʻi hoʻo folofola, ʻo hangē ko e taha ʻoku ne ʻilo ʻae koloa lahi.
I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
‌ʻOku ou fehiʻa mo fākaliliʻa ki he loi: ka ʻoku ou ʻofa ki hoʻo fono.
I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
‌ʻOku ou fakamālō kiate koe ʻo liunga fitu ʻi he ʻaho, koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau māʻoniʻoni.
Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
‌ʻOku maʻu ʻae fiemālie lahi ʻekinautolu ʻoku ʻofa ki hoʻo fono: pea ʻe ʻikai tūkia ʻakinautolu ʻi ha meʻa.
Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
‌ʻE Sihova, kuo u ʻamanaki ki hoʻo fakamoʻui, pea kuo u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau.
LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
Kuo tauhi ʻe hoku laumālie ʻa hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni; pea ʻoku ou ʻofa lahi ʻaupito ki ai.
My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
Kuo u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki mo hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni: he ʻoku ʻi ho ʻao hoku ngaahi ʻaluʻanga kotoa pē.
I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
‌ʻE Sihova, tuku ke aʻu atu ʻeku tangi ʻo ofi kiate koe: ke ke foaki mai ʻae poto ʻo hangē ko hoʻo folofola.
Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
Tuku ke aʻu atu ʻeku lotu tāumaʻu ki ho ʻao: fakamoʻui au ʻo hangē ko hoʻo folofola.
Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
‌ʻE huaʻaki ʻe hoku loungutu ʻae fakamālō, ʻoka ke ka ako hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni kiate au.
My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
‌ʻE lea ʻaki ʻe hoku ʻelelo hoʻo folofola: he ʻoku māʻoniʻoni hoʻo ngaahi fekau kotoa pē.
My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
Ke tokoni au ʻe ho nima; he kuo u fili hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.
Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou holi ki hoʻo fakamoʻui; pea ko hoʻo fono ko hoku fiefiaʻanga ia.
I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
Tuku ke moʻui ʻa hoku laumālie, pea ʻe fakamālō ia kiate koe; pea ke tokoni au ʻe hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.
Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
Naʻaku hē ʻo hangē ko e sipi kuo mole; ke ke kumi hoʻo tamaioʻeiki; he ʻoku ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo ngaahi fekau.
I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
Naʻaku tangi kia Sihova ʻi heʻeku mamahi, pea naʻa ne ongoʻi au.
In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
‌ʻE Sihova, fakahaofi hoku laumālie mei he loungutu loi, pea mei he ʻelelo kākā.
Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
Ko e hā ʻe ʻatu kiate koe? He ko e hā ʻe fai kiate koe, ʻa koe ko e ʻelelo kākā?
What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
‌ʻAe ngaahi ngahau māsila ʻae tangata mālohi, mo e ngaahi malalaʻi afi ʻoe sunipa.
Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
‌ʻOku ou malaʻia, ko e meʻa ʻi heʻeku ʻāunofo ʻi Meseki, koeʻuhi ko ʻeku nofo ʻi he ngaahi fale fehikitaki ʻo Keta!
Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
Kuo nofo ʻo fuoloa ʻa hoku laumālie fakataha mo ia ʻoku ne fehiʻa ki he melino.
My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
‌ʻOku ou loto ki he melino: ka ʻi heʻeku lea ʻoku nau fie tau.
I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
Te u hanga hake hoku mata ki he ngaahi moʻunga, ʻaia ʻoku haʻu mei ai hoku tokoni.
I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
‌ʻOku haʻu hoku tokoni meia Sihova, ʻaia ne ne ngaohi ʻae langi mo māmani.
My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
‌ʻE ʻikai tuku ʻe ia ke hiki ho vaʻe: ko ia ʻoku ne tauhi koe ʻe ʻikai tulemohe ia.
He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
Vakai, ko ia ʻoku ne tauhi ʻa ʻIsileli ʻe ʻikai te ne tulemohe pe mohe.
Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
Ko Sihova ko ho tauhi: ko Sihova ko ho fakamalu ia ʻi ho nima toʻomataʻu.
The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
‌ʻE ʻikai taaʻi koe ʻe he laʻā ʻi he ʻaho, pe ʻe he māhina ʻi he pō.
The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
‌ʻE fakahaofi koe ʻe Sihova mei he kovi kotoa pē: te ne fakamoʻui ho laumālie.
The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
‌ʻE tauhi ʻe Sihova hoʻo ʻalu kituʻa mo hoʻo liu mai mei he ʻaho ni, pea taʻengata.
The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
Naʻaku fiefia ʻi heʻenau pehē mai kiate au, “Ke tau ō ki he fale ʻo Sihova.”
I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
‌ʻE tuʻu homau vaʻe ki lotoʻā ʻi ho ngaahi matapā, ʻE Selūsalema.
Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
Kuo langa ʻa Selūsalema ʻo hangē ko e kolo ʻoku māʻopoʻopo:
Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
‌ʻAia ʻoku ʻalu hake ki ai ʻae ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻae ngaahi faʻahinga ʻo Sihova, ki he fakamoʻoni ʻa ʻIsileli, ke ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ki he huafa ʻo Sihova.
Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
He ʻoku fokotuʻu ʻi ai ʻae ngaahi nofoʻa ʻoe fakamaau, ko e ngaahi nofoʻa ʻoe fale ʻo Tevita.
For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
Mou hūfia ke melino ʻa Selūsalema: “ʻE monūʻia ʻakinautolu ʻoku nau ʻofa kiate koe.
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
Ke ʻai ʻae melino ʻi ho ngaahi lotoʻā maka, mo e monūʻia ʻi ho ngaahi fale fakaʻeiʻeiki.”
Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
Pea koeʻuhi ko hoku ngaahi kāinga mo hoku ngaahi kaumeʻa, te u lea ni, “Ke ʻiate koe ʻae melino.”
For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
Koeʻuhi ko e fale ʻo Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua, te u kumi ke ke lelei ai.
Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
‌ʻOku ou hanga hake hoku mata ki hoʻo ʻafio, ʻa koe ʻoku ke ʻafio ʻi he ngaahi langi.
Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

Vakai, ʻoku hangē ko e sio ʻae mata ʻoe kau tamaioʻeiki ki he nima ʻo ʻenau ngaahi ʻeiki, pea hangē ko e mata ʻo ha kaunanga ki he nima ʻo ʻene ʻeiki fefine; ʻoku tatali pehē ʻa homau mata kia Sihova ko homau ʻOtua, kaeʻoua ke ne ʻaloʻofa mai kiate kimautolu.

Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
‌ʻE Sihova, ke ke ʻaloʻofa mai kiate kimautolu, ke ke ʻaloʻofa mai kiate kimautolu: he kuo mau fonu ʻaupito ʻi he manukia.
Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
‌ʻOku fonu ʻaupito homau laumālie ʻi he manuki ʻanautolu ʻoku anga fakafiemālie, pea mo e fehiʻa ʻae fielahi.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
Kapau naʻe ʻikai kau ʻa Sihova mo kitautolu, ʻoku totonu ke lea ni ʻa ʻIsileli;
If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
“Kapau naʻe ʻikai kau ʻa Sihova mo kitautolu, ʻi he tuʻu hake ʻae kakai kiate kitautolu:
If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
Pehē, kuo nau folo hifo leva ʻakitautolu, ʻi he tupu ʻenau ʻita kiate kitautolu;
Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
Pehē, kuo lōfia ʻakitautolu ʻe he ngaahi vai, kuo tafe ʻae vaitafe ʻi he funga ʻo hotau laumālie:
Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
Pea ʻalu ʻae ngaahi vai ʻoe laukau ʻi he funga ʻo hotau laumālie.”
Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻaia naʻe ʻikai te ne tukuange ʻakitautolu ko e meʻakai ki honau nifo.
Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
Kuo hao hotau laumālie ʻo hangē ko e manupuna mei he hele ʻae tangata tauhele: kuo maumauʻi ʻae tauhele, pea kuo tau hao ai.
Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
Ko hotau tokoni ʻoku ʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova, ʻaia naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae langi mo māmani.
Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
Ko kinautolu ʻoku falala kia Sihova tenau tatau mo e moʻunga ko Saione, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai siʻi faʻa hiki, kae tuʻumaʻu pe ʻo taʻengata.
They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
Hangē ko e takatakai ʻe he ngaahi moʻunga ʻa Selūsalema, ʻoku takatakai pehē ʻe Sihova ʻa hono kakai mei he ʻaho ni ʻo lauikuonga.
As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
Koeʻuhi ʻe ʻikai tuku maʻu ʻae tokotoko ʻoe angahala ʻi he tofiʻa ʻoe angatonu; telia naʻa mafao atu ʻe he angatonu honau nima ki he angahala.
For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
‌ʻE Sihova, ke ke fai lelei kiate kinautolu ʻoku angalelei, pea kiate kinautolu ʻoku angatonu ʻi honau loto.
Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
Ka ko kinautolu ʻoku nau afe ki honau ngaahi hala pikopiko, ʻe tataki atu ʻakinautolu ʻe Sihova fakataha mo e kakai fai kovi: ka ʻe hoko ʻae melino ki ʻIsileli.
As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
‌ʻI he toe liliu ʻe Sihova ʻae pōpula ʻo Saione, naʻa tau tatau mo kinautolu ʻoku misi.
When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
Pea naʻe toki fakapito ʻaki hotau ngutu ʻae kata, mo hotau ʻelelo ʻi he hiva: pea naʻe toki pehē ʻe he hiteni, “Kuo fai ʻe Sihova ʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi maʻanautolu.”
Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
Kuo fai ʻe Sihova ʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi maʻatautolu; pea ʻoku tau fiefia ai.
The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
‌ʻE Sihova, ke ke toe liliu ʻemau pōpula, ʻo hangē ko e ngaahi vaitafe ʻi he feituʻu tonga.
Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
Ko kinautolu ʻoku tūtuuʻi ʻi he loʻimata te nau tuʻusi ʻi he fiefia.
They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
Ko ia ʻoku ne ʻalu atu ʻo tangi, pea ʻave ʻae tenga mahuʻinga, te ne toe haʻu ʻi he fiefia, mo ʻomi ʻene ngaahi ū uite fakataha mo ia.
He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
Kapau ʻe ʻikai langa ʻe Sihova ʻae fale, ʻoku taʻeʻaonga ʻae ngāue ʻanautolu ʻoku nau langa ia: kapau ʻe ʻikai tauhi ʻe Sihova ʻae kolo, ʻoku taʻeʻaonga ʻae ʻā ʻae tangata leʻo.
Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
‌ʻOku taʻeʻaonga hoʻomou tuʻu hake hengihengi pē, mo nofo pē ʻo fuoloa ʻi he pō, ke kai ʻae mā ʻoe mamahi: he ʻoku ne foaki ʻae mohe ki heʻene pele.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
Vakai, ko e fānau ko e tofiʻa meia Sihova: pea ko e fua ʻoe manāva ko ʻene totongi.
Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
Hangē ko e ngaahi ngahau ʻi he nima ʻoe tangata mālohi; ʻoku pehē ʻae fānau ʻae talavou.
As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻae tangata ʻaia ʻoku fonu ʻene hōfangahau ʻiate kinautolu: ʻe ʻikai tenau mā, ka tenau lea ki he ngaahi fili ʻi he matapā.
Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku manavahē kia Sihova; ʻaia ʻoku ʻaʻeva ʻi hono ngaahi hala.
Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
He te ke kai ʻae ngāue ʻa ho nima: te ke monūʻia, pea ʻe hoko ʻae lelei kiate koe.
For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
‌ʻE tatau ho uaifi mo e vaine ʻoku faʻa fua ʻi ho veʻe fale: ʻe tatau hoʻo fānau mo e ngaahi vaʻa ʻolive ʻoku kāpui hoʻo keinangaʻanga.
Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
Vakai, ʻe pehē ʻae monūʻia ʻoe tangata ʻaia ʻoku ne manavahē kia Sihova.
Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
‌ʻE tāpuaki koe ʻe Sihova mei Saione: pea te ke mamata ki hono lelei ʻo Selūsalema ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho kotoa pē ʻo hoʻo moʻui.
The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
‌ʻIo, te ke mamata ki he fānau ʻa hoʻo fānau pea mo e melino ʻi ʻIsileli.
Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children, and peace upon Israel.
‌ʻOku totonu ke lea ni ʻa ʻIsileli, Kuo liunga lahi ʻenau fakamamahiʻi au talu ʻeku kei talavou:
Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
“Kuo liunga lahi ʻenau fakamamahiʻi au talu ʻeku talavou: ka naʻe ʻikai tenau mālohi kiate au.
Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
Naʻe keli ʻae kau tangata keli ʻi hoku tuʻa: naʻa nau ngaohi ke lōloa ʻenau ngaahi keli.
The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
‌ʻOku angatonu ʻa Sihova: kuo tuʻusi ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi afo ʻae kakai angahala.”
The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
Tuku ke puputuʻu pea foki kimui ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku fehiʻa ki Saione.
Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
Tuku kenau tatau mo e mohuku ʻi he tatā ʻoe fale, ʻaia ʻoku mae ʻi he teʻeki ai ke lahi ia:
Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
‌ʻAia ʻoku ʻikai fakapito ʻaki ʻe he tangata tuʻusi ʻa hono nima; pe ko e fatafata ʻo ia ʻoku ne nonoʻo ʻae ngaahi ʻū mohuku.
Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
Pea ʻoku ʻikai lea ʻakinautolu ʻoku ʻalu ʻi ai, ʻo pehē, “Ke ʻiate kimoutolu ʻae monūʻia meia Sihova: ʻoku mau tāpuaki ʻakimoutolu ʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova.”
Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
‌ʻE Sihova, naʻaku tangi kiate koe mei he ngaahi moana.
Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
‌ʻE ʻEiki, ke ke ongoʻi hoku leʻo: fakatokangaʻi ho fofonga ki he leʻo ʻo ʻeku ngaahi lotu tāumaʻu.
Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
Kapau te ke fakaʻilonga, ʻE Sihova, ʻae ngaahi hia, ʻE ʻEiki, ko hai ʻe faʻa tuʻu?
If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
Ka ʻoku ʻiate koe ʻae fakamolemole, koeʻuhi ke manavahē ai kiate koe.
But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
‌ʻOku ou tatali kia Sihova, ʻoku tatali ʻa hoku laumālie, pea ʻoku ou ʻamanaki lelei ki heʻene folofola.
I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
‌ʻOku tatali ʻa hoku laumālie kia Sihova ʻo lahi hake ʻiate kinautolu ʻoku nau leʻo ki he pongipongi: ʻoku ou pehē, ʻo lahi hake ʻiate kinautolu ʻoku nau leʻo ki he pongipongi.
My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
Ke ʻamanaki ʻa ʻIsileli kia Sihova: he ʻoku ʻia Sihova ʻae ʻaloʻofa, pea ʻoku ʻiate ia ʻae huhuʻi lahi.
Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
Pea te ne huhuʻi ʻa ʻIsileli mei heʻene ngaahi hia kotoa pē.
And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ʻikai fielahi hoku loto, pe fieʻeiki hoku mata: pea ʻoku ʻikai te u kau ʻi he ngaahi meʻa lalahi, pe ʻi he ngaahi meʻa ʻoku māʻolunga hake ʻiate au.
Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
Ko e moʻoni kuo u fakafiemālieʻi mo fakanaʻanaʻaʻi au, ʻo hangē ko e tamasiʻi kuo fakamāvae mei heʻene faʻē: ʻoku tatau hoku laumālie mo e tamasiʻi kuo fakamāvae.
Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
Tuku ke ʻamanaki lelei ʻa ʻIsileli kia Sihova, mei he ʻaho ni pea taʻengata.
Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
‌ʻE Sihova, ke ke manatu kia Tevita, mo ʻene mamahi kotoa pē:
Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:
‌ʻA ʻene fuakava kia Sihova, mo ʻene lea fakapapau ki he ʻOtua mālohi ʻa Sēkope;
How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
“Ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻikai te u ʻalu ki hoku fale nofoʻanga, pe ʻalu hake ki hoku mohenga;
Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
‌ʻE ʻikai te u tuku ʻae mohe ki hoku mata, pe ko e tulemohe ki hoku laumata,
I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
Kaeʻoua ke u ʻilo ha potu moʻo Sihova, ko e ʻafioʻanga ki he ʻOtua mālohi ʻo Sēkope.”
Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
Vakai, naʻa tau fanongo ki ai ʻi ʻEfalata: pea naʻa tau ʻilo ia ʻi he ngaahi ngoue ʻoe vao.
Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
“Te tau hū ki hono ngaahi fale fehikitaki: te tau lotu ʻi hono tuʻunga vaʻe.”
We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
Tuʻu hake, ʻE Sihova, ki ho mālōlōʻanga; ʻa koe, mo e puha ʻoe fuakava ʻo ho mālohi.
Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
Ke kofuʻaki ʻe hoʻo kau taulaʻeiki ʻae angatonu; pea ke kalanga ʻi he fiefia ʻa hoʻo kakai māʻoniʻoni.
Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
Koeʻuhi ko hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ko Tevita, ʻoua naʻa ke fakatafoki ʻae mata ʻo hoʻo pani.
For thy servant David’s sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
Kuo fuakava ʻa Sihova ʻi he moʻoni kia Tevita; ʻe ʻikai te ne liliu mei ai; “Te u fokotuʻu ki ho nofoʻa ʻae fua ʻo ho sino.
The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
Kapau ʻe fai ʻe hoʻo fānau ki heʻeku fuakava mo ʻeku fakamoʻoni ʻaia te u ako kiate kinautolu, ʻe nofo foki ʻenau fānau ʻi ho nofoʻa fakaʻeiʻeiki ʻo lauikuonga.”
If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
He kuo fili ʻe Sihova ʻa Saione; kuo ne finangalo ki ai ko hono ʻafioʻanga.
For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
“Ko hoku mālōlōʻanga eni ʻo taʻengata: te u nofo ʻi heni; he naʻaku finangalo ki ai.
This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
Ko e moʻoni te u tāpuaki lahi hono meʻakai: te u fakamākona ʻa hono kau masiva ʻaki ʻae mā.
I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
Te u fakakofu foki ʻene kau taulaʻeiki ʻaki ʻae fakamoʻui: pea ko ʻene kau māʻoniʻoni tenau kalanga ʻo leʻo lahi ʻi he fiefia.
I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
Te u ngaohi ke moto ai ʻae nifo ʻo Tevita: kuo u tuʻutuʻuni ʻae maama ʻa ʻeku pani.
There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
Te u fakakofuʻaki hono ngaahi fili ʻae mā: ka ʻe maʻuiʻui ʻa hono tatā ʻiate ia.”
His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
Vakai ki hono lelei pea mo hono fakafiemālie, ʻoe nofo fakataha ʻae kāinga ʻi he feʻofoʻofani!
Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
‌ʻOku tatau ia mo e lolo mahuʻinga ki he ʻulu, ʻaia naʻe tafe hifo ki he halakava, ʻio, ko e halakava ʻo ʻElone: pea ʻalu hifo ki he kapa ʻo hono ngaahi kofu;
It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
‌ʻOku hangē ko e hahau ʻo Heamoni, pea hangē ko e hahau naʻe tō ki he ngaahi moʻunga ʻo Saione, he naʻe fekau ʻi ai ʻe Sihova ʻae monūʻia, ʻio, ko e moʻui taʻengata.
As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
Ko eni, mou fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻakimoutolu kotoa pē ko e kau tamaioʻeiki ʻa Sihova, ʻoku mou tuʻu ʻi he pō ʻi he fale ʻo Sihova.
Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.
Hiki hake homou nima ʻi he faletapu, mou fakafetaʻi kia Sihova.
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
Ke tāpuaki koe mei Saione ʻe Sihova; ʻaia naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae langi mo māmani.
The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
Mou fakamālō kia Sihova. Mou fakamālō ki he huafa ʻo Sihova; fakamālō kiate ia, ʻakimoutolu ko e kau tamaioʻeiki ʻa Sihova.
Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.
‌ʻAkimoutolu ʻoku tuʻu ʻi he fale ʻo Sihova, ʻi he ngaahi lotoʻā ʻoe fale ʻo hotau ʻOtua,
Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,
Fakamālō kia Sihova; he ʻoku angalelei ʻa Sihova: hiva fakamālō ki hono huafa; he ʻoku mālie ia.
Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
He kuo fili ʻe Sihova ʻa Sēkope maʻana, mo ʻIsileli ko hono tofiʻa ʻoʻona.
For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
He ʻoku ou ʻilo ʻoku lahi ʻa Sihova, pea ʻoku māʻolunga hake hotau ʻEiki ʻi he ngaahi ʻotua kotoa pē.
For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
Ko e meʻa kotoa pē naʻe finangalo ki ai ʻa Sihova, ko ia naʻa ne fai ʻi he langi, mo māmani, ʻi he ngaahi tahi, mo e ngaahi potu loloto kotoa pē.
Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
‌ʻOku pule ʻe ia ke ʻalu hake ʻae kakapu mei he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻo māmani, ʻoku ne ngaohi ʻae ngaahi ʻuhila mo e ʻuha ʻoku ʻomi, ʻe ia ʻae matangi mei hono ngaahi feleoko.
He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
Ko ia ia naʻe taaʻi ʻae ʻuluaki fānau ʻo ʻIsipite, ʻae tangata mo e manu.
Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
Mo ne fekau atu ʻae ngaahi fakaʻilonga, mo e ngaahi meʻa fakaofo ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoʻou, ʻE ʻIsipite, kia Felo, pea mo ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki kotoa pē.
Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
Ko ia naʻe taaʻi ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga lahi, mo tāmateʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi mālohi;
Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
Ko Sihoni ko e tuʻi ʻoe kau ʻAmoli, mo Oki ko e tuʻi ʻo Pesani, mo e ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pē ʻo Kēnani:
Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
Pea naʻe foaki honau fonua ko e tofiʻa, ko e tofiʻa ki ʻIsileli ko hono kakai.
And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ho huafa; mo ho fakamanatu, ʻE Sihova, ki he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē.
Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
Koeʻuhi ʻe fakamaau ʻe Sihova hono kakai, pea ʻe lolou ia koeʻuhi ko ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki.
For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
Ko e ngaahi tamapua ʻoe hiteni ko e siliva mo e koula, ko e ngāue ʻae nima ʻoe tangata.
The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
‌ʻOku ai honau ngutu, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau lea; ʻoku nau maʻu ʻae mata, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau mamata;
They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
‌ʻOku nau maʻu ʻae telinga, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau fanongo; pea ʻoku ʻikai ha mānava ʻi honau ngutu.
They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
Ko kinautolu ʻoku ngaohi ʻakinautolu ʻoku nau tatau mo kinautolu: pea ʻoku pehē pe ʻakinautolu ʻoku falala ki ai.
They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
‌ʻE fale ʻo ʻIsileli, ke ke fakafetaʻi kia Sihova: ʻE fale ʻo ʻElone, ke ke fakafetaʻi kia Sihova:
Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:
‌ʻE fale ʻo Livai, ke ke fakafetaʻi kia Sihova: ʻakimoutolu ʻoku manavahē kia Sihova, mou fakafetaʻi kia Sihova.
Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
Mou fakafetaʻi kia Sihova mei Saione, ʻaia ʻoku ʻafio ʻi Selūsalema. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova he ʻoku angalelei ia: koeʻuhi ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua ʻoe ngaahi ʻotua: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ki he ʻEiki ʻoe ngaahi ʻeiki: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Kiate ia ʻaia tokotaha pe ʻoku fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa fakaofo lahi: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe ngaohi ʻi he poto ʻae ngaahi langi: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe folahi ʻa māmani ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he ngaahi vai: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe ngaohi ʻae ngaahi maama lahi he ʻoku tolonga, ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa
To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Ko e laʻā ke pule ʻi he ʻaho: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:
The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Ko e māhina mo e ngaahi fetuʻu ke pule ʻi he pō: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe taaʻi ʻa ʻIsipite ʻi heʻenau ʻuluaki fānau: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa
To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Mo ne ʻomi ʻa ʻIsileli meiate kinautolu: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:
And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
‌ʻAki ʻae nima mālohi, mo e nima kuo mafao atu: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Kiate ia naʻe vaheʻi ke vaeua ʻae Tahi Kulokula: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:
To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Pea ne pule ke ʻalu ʻa ʻIsileli ʻi hono vahaʻa: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa
And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Ka naʻe tulaki ʻa Felo mo ʻene kautau ʻi he Tahi Kulokula: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe tataki hono kakai ʻi he toafa: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe taaʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi lahi: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Pea tāmateʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi naʻe ongoongo: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa
And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Ko Sihoni ko e tuʻi ʻoe kau ʻAmoli: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:
Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Mo Oki ko e tuʻi ʻo Pesani: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa
And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Pea ne foaki honau fonua ko e tofiʻa: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:
And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Ko e tofiʻa kia ʻIsileli ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
‌ʻAia naʻe manatu kiate kitautolu ʻi heʻetau masiva: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:
Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Pea ne huhuʻi ʻakitautolu mei hotau ngaahi fili: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
‌ʻOku ne foaki ʻae meʻakai ki he kakano kotoa pē: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua ʻoe langi: he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Naʻa mau nofo ki lalo ʻi he veʻe vaitafe ʻo Papilone, ʻio, naʻa mau tangi ʻi heʻemau manatu ki Saione.
By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
Naʻa mau tautau ʻemau ngaahi haʻape, ʻi he ngaahi uilou ʻi he lotolotonga ʻo ia.
We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

He naʻe fekauʻi ai ʻekinautolu naʻa nau fakapōpulaʻi ʻakimautolu ke mau hiva; pea ko kinautolu naʻe fakaʻosiʻosi ʻakimautolu naʻa nau fekau ke mau fiefia, ʻonau pehē, “Hiva mai kiate kimautolu ʻi he ngaahi hiva ʻo Saione.”
For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
‌ʻE fēfē ʻemau hiva ʻaki ʻae hiva ʻa Sihova ʻi he fonua ʻoe muli?
How shall we sing the LORD’s song in a strange land?
Kapau te u fakangalongaloʻi koe, ʻE Selūsalema, tuku ke ngalo ʻi hoku nima toʻomataʻu hono faiva.
If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
Kapau ʻe ʻikai te u manatu kiate koe, tuku ke pikitai ʻa hoku ʻelelo ki hoku ʻaoʻingutu; ʻo kapau ʻe ʻikai te u hiki māʻolunga hake ʻa Selūsalema ʻi hoku fungani fiefiaʻanga.
If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
Manatu, ʻE Sihova, ki he fānau ʻa ʻItomi, ʻi he ʻaho ʻo Selūsalema; naʻa nau pehē, “Fakaʻauha ia! Fakaʻauha ia, ʻo aʻu ki hono tuʻunga!”
Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
‌ʻE ʻofefine ʻo Papilone, ʻe fakaʻauha koe; ʻe monūʻia ia, ʻaia te ne totongi kiate koe, ʻo hangē ko hoʻo fai kiate kimautolu.
O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
‌ʻE monūʻia ia, ʻaia te ne toʻo ʻo laiki hoʻo fānau iiki ki he maka.
Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
Te u fakamālō kiate koe ʻaki hoku loto kotoa pē: ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ngaahi ʻotua te u hiva fakamālō kiate koe.
I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
Te u lotu ʻo hanga atu ki ho faletapu māʻoniʻoni, mo fakamālō ki ho huafa koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa mo hoʻo moʻoni: he kuo ke hiki ke māʻolunga hake hoʻo folofola ʻi ho huafa kotoa pē.
I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
‌ʻI he ʻaho ne u tangi ai naʻa ke talia au, mo fakamālohi ʻaki au ʻae mālohi ʻi hoku laumālie.
In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻe fakamālō kiate koe ʻae ngaahi tuʻi kotoa pē ʻo māmani, ʻoka nau ka fanongo ki he ngaahi folofola ʻo ho fofonga.
All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
‌ʻIo, tenau hiva ʻi he ngaahi hala ʻo Sihova: he ʻoku lahi ʻae nāunau ʻo Sihova.
Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.
Ko e moʻoni ʻoku māʻolunga ʻa Sihova, ka ʻoku ʻofa ia ki he angavaivai: ka ʻoku ʻilo ʻe ia ʻae laukau ki he mamaʻo.
Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
Neongo ʻeku ʻeveʻeva ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe mamahi, te ke fakaakeake au: te ke mafao atu ho nima ke taʻofi ki he ʻita ʻa hoku ngaahi fili, pea ko ho nima toʻomataʻu te ne fakamoʻui au.
Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
‌ʻE fakahaohaoa ʻe Sihova ʻaia ʻoku kau kiate au: ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa, ʻE Sihova ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata: ʻoua naʻa ke liʻaki ʻae ngaahi ngāue ʻa ho nima ʻoʻou.
The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
‌ʻE Sihova, naʻa ke ʻahiʻahiʻi au, pea kuo ke ʻiloʻi au.
O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
‌ʻOku ke ʻiloʻi ʻeku nofo hifo mo ʻeku tuʻu hake, ʻoku ke ʻiloʻi ʻeku ngaahi mahalo ʻoku kei mamaʻo.
Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
‌ʻOku ke ʻāʻi hoku hala mo hoku tokotoʻanga, pea ʻoku ke ʻiloʻi hoku hala kotoa pē.
Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
He ʻoku ʻikai ha lea ʻi hoku ʻelelo, ka ko koe, ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ke ʻiloʻi kotoa pē.
For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
Naʻa ke kāpui au ʻi hoku tuʻa mo hoku ʻao, ʻo ke hilifaki ho nima kiate au.
Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
Ko e ʻilo pehē ʻoku fakaofo lahi kiate au; ʻoku māʻolunga ia, ʻoku ʻikai te u faʻa lavaʻi ia.
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
Te u ʻalu ki fē mei ho Laumālie? Pe te u hola ki fē mei ho ʻao?
Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
Kapau te u ʻalu hake ki he loto langi, ʻoku ke ʻi ai: kapau te u ngaohi hoku mohenga ʻi heli, vakai, ʻoku ke ʻi ai.
If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
Kapau te u toʻo mai ʻae ngaahi kapakau ʻoe pongipongi, pea nofo ʻi he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻoe tahi;
If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
‌ʻE tataki foki au ʻe ho nima ʻi ai, pea ko ho nima toʻomataʻu te ne puke au.
Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
Kapau te u pehē, Ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻufiʻufi au ʻe he poʻuli; ʻe hoko ʻae pō foki ko e maama ʻo takatakai ʻiate au.
If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
‌ʻIo, ʻoku ʻikai fakafufū meiate koe ʻe he poʻuli, ka ʻoku malama ʻae pō ʻo hangē ko e ʻaho: ko e poʻuli mo e maama ʻoku na tatau pe kiate koe.
Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
He kuo ke maʻu hoku kongaloto: naʻa ke ʻufiʻufi au ʻi he manāva ʻo ʻeku faʻē.
For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.
Te u fakamālō kiate koe; he ʻoku fakamanavahē mo fakaofo hoku ngaohi: ʻoku fakaofo hoʻo ngaahi ngāue; pea ʻoku ʻilo pau ki ai ʻe hoku laumālie.
I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
Naʻe ʻikai fufū ʻa hoku sino meiate koe, ʻi he ngaohi au ʻi he lilo, mo teuteu lelei au ʻi he ngaahi potu māʻulalo ʻoe fonua.
My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
Naʻe ʻafio ho fofonga ki hoku sino ʻoku teʻeki ai fakaʻosi; pea naʻe tohi ʻi hoʻo tohi hoku ngaahi kupuʻi sino kotoa pē, ʻaia naʻe fakatupu fakaholo, ʻi he teʻeki ai ha kupu ʻe taha.
Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
‌ʻE ʻOtua, hono ʻikai mahuʻinga ʻa hoʻo ngaahi fakakaukau kiate au! ʻOku fēfē nai hono lahi ʻo ia!
How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
Kapau te u lau ia, ʻoku lahi hake hono lau ʻi he ʻoneʻone: ʻo kau ka ʻā hake ʻoku ou kei ʻiate koe.
If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
‌ʻE ʻOtua, ko e moʻoni te ke tāmateʻi ʻae angahala: ko ia mou ʻalu ʻiate au, ʻakimoutolu ʻae kau tangata pani toto.
Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
He ʻoku nau lea kovi ʻi he angatuʻu kiate koe, pea ko ho ngaahi fili ʻoku nau takuanoa ho huafa.
For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻikai ʻoku ou fehiʻa kiate kinautolu ʻoku nau fehiʻa kiate koe? Pea ʻikai ʻoku ou mamahi ʻiate kinautolu ʻoku nau tuʻu hake ʻo angatuʻu kiate koe?
Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
‌ʻOku ou fehiʻa kiate kinautolu ʻaki ʻae fehiʻa ʻaupito: ʻoku ou lau ʻakinautolu ko hoku ngaahi fili.
I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻafioʻi au, pea ke ʻiloʻi hoku loto: ʻahiʻahiʻi au, mo ke ʻiloʻi ʻeku ngaahi mahalo:
Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
Pea ke vakai pe ʻoku ai ha hala kovi ʻiate au, pea ke tataki au ʻi he hala taʻengata.
And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
‌ʻE Sihova, fakamoʻui au mei he tangata angakovi: fakamoʻui au mei he tangata fakamālohi;
Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
‌ʻAia ʻoku mahalo kovi ʻi honau loto; ʻoku nau fakataha maʻuaipē ke tau.
Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
Kuo nau fakamāsila honau ʻelelo ʻo hangē ko e ngata; ʻoku ʻai ʻae kona ʻoe ngata ʻi honau lalo loungutu. Sila.
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.
Fakahaofi au, ʻE Sihova, mei he nima ʻoe angahala; fakamoʻui au mei he tangata fakamālohi, ʻaia kuo ne fakakaukau ke tulaki hifo hoku vaʻe.
Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
Kuo tau fufū ʻe he laukau ʻae tauhele kiate au, mo e ngaahi afo; kuo nau ʻaʻau ʻae kupenga ʻi he veʻe hala; kuo nau teuteu ʻae ngaahi hele kiate au. Sila.
The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
Naʻaku pehē kia Sihova, “Ko koe ko hoku ʻOtua:” ʻE Sihova, ke ke ongoʻi ʻae leʻo ʻo ʻeku ngaahi lotu tāumaʻu.
I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
‌ʻE Sihova ko e ʻEiki, ko e mālohi ʻo ʻeku fakamoʻui, kuo ke maluʻi hoku ʻulu ʻi he ʻaho ʻoe tau.
O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoua naʻa ke fai ki he ngaahi holi ʻae angahala: ʻoua naʻa ke tokoni ʻene fakakaukau kovi, telia naʻa nau hiki hake ʻakinautolu. Sila.
Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
Ka ko e ʻulu ʻokinautolu ʻoku nau kāpui au, tuku ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ʻakinautolu ʻae kovi ʻo honau loungutu.
As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
Ke tō kiate kinautolu ʻae malalaʻi afi ʻoku vela: tuku ke lī ʻakinautolu ki he afi; ki he ngaahi luo tau mamaʻo, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa nau toetuʻu hake.
Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
‌ʻOua naʻa tuku ha tangata lea kovi ke tuʻumaʻu ʻi māmani: ʻe tuli ʻe he kovi ʻae tangata fakamālohi ke tulaki ia.
Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
‌ʻOku ou ʻilo ʻe fakamaau ʻe Sihova ʻae meʻa ʻae mamahi, mo e ʻinasi totonu ʻoe masiva.
I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
Ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ʻe he māʻoniʻoni ki ho huafa: ʻe nofo ʻae angatonu ʻi ho ʻao.
Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou tangi kiate koe: ke ke haʻu vave kiate au; fakafanongo ki hoku leʻo, ʻo kau ka tangi kiate koe.
Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
Ke aʻu atu ʻeku lotu ki ho ʻao ʻo hangē ko e meʻa namu kakala; mo e hiki hake ʻo hoku nima ʻo hangē ko e feilaulau ʻoe efiafi.
Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
‌ʻE Sihova, fakanofo ʻae leʻo ki hoku ngutu; tauhi ʻae matapā ʻo hoku loungutu.
Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
‌ʻOua naʻa ueʻi hoku loto ki ha meʻa kovi ʻe taha, ke fai ʻae ngaahi ngāue kovi mo e kau tangata ʻoku fai kovi: pea ʻoua naʻa tuku ke u kai ʻi heʻenau ngaahi meʻa lelei.
Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
Ke taaʻi au ʻe he angatonu; pea ko e ʻofa ia: pea tuku ke ne valokiʻi au; ko e lolo lelei ia, ʻaia ʻe ʻikai foa ai hoku ʻulu: he ko ʻeku lotu foki ʻe fai ia ʻi heʻenau ngaahi mamahi.
Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
‌ʻOka hinga ʻenau kau fakamaau ʻi he ngaahi potu tokatāmaki, tenau fanongo ki heʻeku ngaahi lea; he ʻoku melie ia.
When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
Kuo movetevete hotau ngaahi hui ʻi he ngutu ʻoe faʻitoka, ʻo hangē ko e taaʻi ʻo mafahi ʻe he taha ʻae ʻakau ʻi he funga ʻoe fonua.
Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
Ka ʻoku hanga hoku mata kiate koe, ʻE Sihova ko e ʻEiki: ʻoku ou falala kiate koe; ʻoua naʻa ke siʻaki hoku laumālie.
But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
Taʻofi au mei he ngaahi tauhele kuo nau ʻai kiate au, mo e ngaahi meʻa fakauʻu, ʻae kakai fai kovi.
Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
Tuku ke tō ʻae angahala ki he ngaahi kupenga ʻanautolu, ʻi he lolotonga ʻo ʻeku hao mei ai.
Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
Naʻaku tangi kia Sihova ʻaki hoku leʻo; ne u kole tāumaʻu kia Sihova ʻaki hoku leʻo.
I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
Naʻaku lilingi ʻeku fakakaukau ʻi hono ʻao; ne u fakahā ʻi hono ʻao ʻeku mamahi.
I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
‌ʻI he taʻomia ʻa hoku laumālie, ne ke ʻilo ai hoku ʻaluʻanga. ʻI he hala ne u ʻeveʻeva ai kuo nau ʻai fufū ʻae tauhele kiate au.
When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
Ne u sio, mo vakai ʻi hoku nima toʻomataʻu, ka naʻe ʻikai ha tangata te ne ʻiloʻi au: naʻe ʻikai haʻaku hūfanga; naʻe ʻikai tokanga ha tangata ki hoku laumālie.
I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
Naʻaku tangi kiate koe, ʻE Sihova; ne u pehē, Ko koe ko hoku hūfanga, mo hoku ʻinasi ʻi he fonua ʻoe moʻui.
I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
Ke ke tokanga ki heʻeku tangi; he ʻoku ou vaivai ʻaupito: fakamoʻui au mei hoku kau fakatanga; he ʻoku nau mālohi hake kiate au.
Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
‌ʻOmi hoku laumālie mei he fale fakapōpula, koeʻuhi ke u fakamālō ai ki ho huafa: ʻe kāpui au ʻe he angatonu; he te ke fai lelei lahi kiate au.
Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
‌ʻE Sihova, fanongo ki heʻeku lotu, fakafanongo ki heʻeku ngaahi lotu tāumaʻu: pea ʻi hoʻo moʻoni mo hoʻo māʻoniʻoni, ke ke talia au.
Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
Pea ʻoua naʻa ke fakamaauʻi hoʻo tamaioʻeiki: koeʻuhi ʻe ʻikai tonuhia ʻi ho ʻao ha tangata moʻui ʻe tokotaha.
And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
He kuo fakatanga hoku laumālie ʻe he fili; kuo ne taaʻi hifo ʻeku moʻui ki he kelekele; kuo ne pule ke u nofo ʻi he poʻuli, ʻo hangē ko kinautolu kuo fuoloa ʻenau mate.
For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
Ko ia kuo taʻomia ai ʻa hoku laumālie; kuo lala hoku loto ʻiate au.
Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
‌ʻOku ou manatu ki he ngaahi ʻaho ʻi muʻa; ʻoku ou fakalaulauloto ki hoʻo ngāue kotoa pē; ʻoku ou fifili ki he ngāue ʻa ho nima.
I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
‌ʻOku ou mafao atu hoku nima kiate koe: ʻoku holi ʻa hoku laumālie kiate koe, ʻo hangē ko e fonua fieinua. Sila.
I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻafio vave kiate au: kuo vaivai ʻa hoku laumālie: ʻoua naʻa fufū ho fofonga ʻiate au, telia naʻaku tatau mo kinautolu ʻoku nau ʻalu hifo ki he luo.
Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

Ke ke fakatokangaʻi au ke u fanongo ki hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ʻi he pongipongi; he ʻoku ou falala kiate koe: fakaʻilo mai kiate au ʻae hala ʻaia ʻoku totonu ke u ʻalu ai; he ʻoku ou hiki hake hoku laumālie kiate koe.
Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
Fakamoʻui au, ʻE Sihova, mei hoku ngaahi fili: ʻoku ou hola kiate koe ke fakafufū au,
Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
Akonakiʻi au ke u fai ki ho finangalo; he ko koe ko hoku ʻOtua; tuku ke tataki au ʻe ho Laumālie lelei, ki he fonua ʻoe angatonu.
Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
‌ʻE Sihova, fakamoʻui au koeʻuhi ko ho huafa: koeʻuhi ko hoʻo māʻoniʻoni ke ke ʻomi hoku laumālie mei he mamahi.
Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name’s sake: for thy righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.
Pea ʻi hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ke ke motuhi hoku ngaahi fili, mo fakaʻauha ʻakinautolu ʻoku nau fakamamahi ki hoku laumālie: he ko hoʻo tamaioʻeiki au.
And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
Ke monūʻia pē ʻa Sihova ko hoku makatuʻu, ʻaia ʻoku ne ako ki hoku nima ketau, mo hoku louhiʻi nima ke tau:
Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
Ko hoku leleiʻanga, mo ʻeku kolo: mo hoku fale māʻolunga, mo hoku fakamoʻui; ko hoku fakaū, pea ko ia ʻoku ou falala ki ai; ʻoku ne fakamoʻulaloaʻi hoku kakai kiate au.
My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
‌ʻE Sihova, ko e hā ʻae tangata, ʻoku ke tokanga ai kiate ia! Pe ko e foha ʻoe tangata, koeʻuhi ʻoku ke finangalo kiate ia!
LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
‌ʻOku tatau ʻae tangata mo e meʻa vaʻinga: ko hono ngaahi ʻaho ʻoku hangē ko e ʻata ʻoku mole atu.
Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
Ofeʻi hifo, ʻE Sihova, ho ngaahi langi, pea ke hāʻele hifo: ala ki he ngaahi moʻunga, pea tenau kohu ai.
Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
Lī atu ʻae ʻuhila, pea fakamovete ʻakinautolu: fanaʻi atu hoʻo ngaahi ngahau, mo fakaʻauha ʻakinautolu.
Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
Fekau mai ho nima mei ʻolunga; fakamoʻui au, mo fakahaofi au mei he ngaahi vai lahi, mei he nima ʻoe fānau ʻae muli;
Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
‌ʻAkinautolu ʻoku lea ʻaki ʻe honau ngutu ʻae vaʻinga, pea ko honau nima toʻomataʻu ko e nima toʻomataʻu ʻoe loi.
Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
‌ʻE ʻOtua, te u hiva ʻaki ʻae hiva foʻou kiate koe: te u hiva fakamālō kiate koe ʻaki ʻae saliteli mo e meʻa faiva ʻoku filo ʻe hongofulu.
I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
Ko ia ia ʻoku ne foaki ʻae fakamoʻui ki he ngaahi tuʻi: ʻoku ne fakamoʻui ʻa Tevita ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki mei he heletā ʻoe kovi.
It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
Fakamoʻui au, mo fakahaofi au mei he nima ʻoe fānau ʻae muli; ʻakinautolu ʻoku lea ʻaki ʻe honau ngutu ʻae vaʻinga, pea ko honau nima toʻomataʻu ko e nima toʻomataʻu ʻoe loi:
Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
Koeʻuhi ke tatau homau ngaahi foha mo e ngaahi ʻakau naʻe tupu ʻi heʻenau talavou; ke tatau homau ngaahi ʻofefine mo e ngaahi maka ʻoe tuliki, kuo tā ʻo fakatatau mo e fale fakaʻeiʻeiki:
That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
Koeʻuhi ke pito ai homau ngaahi feleoko, ʻoku ʻomi mei ai ʻae meʻakai kehekehe kotoa pē: ke fānau ʻemau ngaahi fanga sipi ʻi he lauʻi afe mo e lauʻi mano ʻi homau ngaahi hala:
That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
Ke mālohi ai ʻemau fanga pulu tangata ke ngāue; ke ʻoua naʻa ai ʻae ʻoho mai, pē ʻae hola kituaʻā; ke ʻoua naʻa ai ha lāunga ʻi homau ngaahi hala.
That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻae kakai ko ia, ʻaia ʻoku pehē: ʻio, ʻoku monūʻia ʻae kakai ko ia, ʻoku ʻOtua ʻaki ʻa Sihova.
Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.
Te u fakahikihiki koe, ko hoku ʻOtua, ko e tuʻi; pea te u fakafetaʻi ki ho huafa ʻo lauikuonga pea taʻengata.
I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
Te u fakafetaʻi kiate koe ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē; pea te u fakamālō ki ho huafa ʻo lauikuonga pea taʻengata.
Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
‌ʻOku lahi ʻa Sihova, pea ʻoku ngali ke faʻa fakamālō kiate ia; pea ko hono lahi ʻoku taʻefaʻaʻiloʻi.
Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
‌ʻE fakamālō ʻae toʻutangata ʻe taha ki hoʻo ngaahi ngāue ʻo aʻu ki he taha, pea tenau fakahā hoʻo ngaahi ngāue lahi.
One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
Te u lea ki hono ongoongolelei lahi ʻo hoʻo ʻafio, pea mo hoʻo ngaahi ngāue fakaofo.
I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
Pea ʻe lea ʻae kakai ki hono mālohi ʻo hoʻo ngaahi ngāue fakailifia: pea te u fakahā hoʻo māfimafi.
And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
Tenau faʻa fakahā ʻae fakamanatu ʻo hoʻo ʻulungāanga lelei lahi, pea tenau hiva ʻaki hoʻo māʻoniʻoni.
They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
‌ʻOku angalelei ʻa Sihova, pea fonu ʻi he manavaʻofa; ʻoku tōʻohi hono houhau, pea ʻoku lahi ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
‌ʻOku angalelei ʻa Sihova ki he kakai kotoa pē: pea ʻoku kāpui ʻene ngāue kotoa pē ʻe heʻene ngaahi ʻaloʻofa ongongofua.
The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻe fakamālō kiate koe ʻa hoʻo ngaahi ngāue kotoa pē; pea ʻe fakafetaʻi kiate koe ʻa hoʻo kakai māʻoniʻoni.
All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.
Tenau lea ki he nāunau ʻo ho puleʻanga, pea talanoa ki hoʻo māfimafi;
They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
Ke fakaʻilo ki he ngaahi foha ʻoe tangata ʻene ngaahi ngāue lahi, pea mo e ongoongolelei lahi ʻo hono puleʻanga.
