To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
Ko ho puleʻanga ko e puleʻanga taʻengata, pea ko hoʻo pule ʻoku tolonga ia ʻi he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē.
Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
‌ʻOku poupou hake ʻe Sihova ʻakinautolu kotoa pē kuo hinga, pea ʻoku ne fokotuʻu ʻakinautolu kotoa pē kuo mapelu ki lalo.
The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
‌ʻOku hanga ʻae ngaahi mata kotoa pē kiate koe; pea ʻoku ke foaki ʻenau meʻakai ʻi he feituʻulaʻā totonu.
The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
‌ʻOku ke mafola ho nima, mo fakamākona ʻae holi ʻae meʻa moʻui kotoa pē.
Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
‌ʻOku angatonu ʻa Sihova ʻi hono hala kotoa pē, pea māʻoniʻoni ʻi heʻene ngaahi ngāue kotoa pē.
The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
‌ʻOku ofi ʻa Sihova kiate kinautolu kotoa pē kuo ui ki heʻene ʻafio, kiate kinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku nau ui kiate ia ʻi he moʻoni.
The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
Te ne fai ki he holi ʻanautolu ʻoku manavahē kiate ia: ʻe fanongo foki ia ki heʻenau tangi, pea te ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu.
He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
‌ʻOku fakamoʻui ʻe Sihova ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku nau ʻofa kiate ia: ka ko e angakovi kotoa pē te ne fakaʻauha.
The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
‌ʻE lea ʻaki ʻe hoku ngutu ʻae fakamālō kia Sihova: pea tuku ke fakafetaʻi ʻae kakano kotoa pē ki hono huafa māʻoniʻoni ʻo lauikuonga pea taʻengata.
My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
Mou fakamālō kia Sihova. Fakamālō kia Sihova, ʻE hoku laumālie.
Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
Te u fakamālō kia Sihova ʻi heʻeku kei moʻui: te u hiva fakamālō ki hoku ʻOtua ʻi he lolotonga ʻo ʻeku moʻui.
While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
‌ʻOua naʻa mou falala ki he ngaahi ʻeiki, pe ki he foha ʻoe tangata, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai ha fakamoʻui ʻiate ia.
Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
‌ʻOku mole atu ʻene mānava, pea ʻoku foki ia ki he kelekele; ʻoku mole ai ʻi he ʻaho ko ia ʻene ngaahi mahalo.
His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
‌ʻOku monūʻia ia ʻaia ʻoku ne maʻu ʻae ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope ko hono tokoni, pea ko ʻene ʻamanaki lelei ʻoku ʻia Sihova ko hono ʻOtua:
Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:
‌ʻAia naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae langi, mo māmani, ʻae tahi mo e meʻa kotoa pē ʻoku ʻi ai: pea ʻoku ne tauhi ʻae moʻoni ʻo lauikuonga:
Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:
‌ʻAia ʻoku ne fai ʻae fakamaau koeʻuhi ko e kakai fakamālohia: ʻoku ne foaki ʻae meʻakai ki he fiekaia. ʻOku vete ʻe Sihova ʻae kau pōpula:
Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:
‌ʻOku fakaʻā ʻe Sihova ʻae kui: ʻoku fokotuʻu ʻe Sihova ʻakinautolu kuo mapelu ki lalo: ʻoku ʻofa ʻa Sihova ki he angatonu:
The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:
‌ʻOku fakamoʻui ʻe Sihova ʻae kakai muli; ʻoku ne fakafiemālieʻi ʻae tamai mate mo e fefine kuo mate hono husepāniti: ka ko e hala ʻoe angahala ʻoku ne fulihi ia.
The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
‌ʻE pule ʻa Sihova ʻo taʻengata, ʻio, ko ho ʻOtua, ʻE Saione, ʻi he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
Mou fakamālō kia Sihova: he ʻoku lelei ke hiva fakamālō ki hotau ʻOtua; he ʻoku mālie ia; pea ʻoku ngali ʻae fakamālō.
Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
‌ʻOku langa hake ʻe Sihova ʻa Selūsalema: ʻoku ne tānaki fakataha ʻae kau ʻIsileli naʻe fakahēʻi
The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
‌ʻOku ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu ʻoku loto mafesi, ʻo ne nonoʻo honau ngaahi lavea.
He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
‌ʻOku ne tala hono lau ʻoe ngaahi fetuʻu; ʻoku ne ui ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻi honau ngaahi hingoa.
He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
Ko hotau ʻEiki ʻoku lahi ia, pea lahi hono mālohi: ko ʻene ʻilo ʻoku taʻengata.
Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
‌ʻOku hiki hake ʻe Sihova ʻae angamalū: ʻoku lī ʻe ia ʻae angahala ki he kelekele.
The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
Hiva kia Sihova ʻaki ʻae fakafetaʻi; hiva fakamālō ʻi he haʻape ki hotau ʻOtua:
Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
‌ʻAia ʻoku ne ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ʻae langi ʻae ngaahi ʻao, ʻoku ne teuteu ʻae ʻuha ki he kelekele, mo ne fakatupu ʻae mohuku ʻi he ngaahi moʻunga.
Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
‌ʻOku ne foaki ki he manu ʻene meʻakai, pea ki he fanga leveni iiki ʻaia ʻoku tangi.
He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
‌ʻOku ʻikai fiefia ia ʻi he mālohi ʻoe hoosi: ʻoku ʻikai fiefia ia ʻi he kau vaʻe ʻoe tangata.
He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
‌ʻOku fiefia ʻa Sihova ʻiate kinautolu ʻoku nau manavahē kiate ia, ʻiate kinautolu ʻoku nau ʻamanaki ki heʻene ʻaloʻofa.
The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
Fakamālō kia Sihova, ʻE Selūsalema; fakamālō ki ho ʻOtua, ʻE Saione.
Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
He kuo ne fakamālohi ʻae ngaahi songo ʻo ho ngaahi matapā; kuo ne tāpuakiʻi hoʻo fānau ʻi loto ʻiate koe.
For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
‌ʻOku fakatupu ʻe ia ʻae melino ʻi ho ngaahi potu, pea ʻoku ne fakamahu ʻaki koe ʻae uite ʻoku fungani lelei.
He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
‌ʻOku ne tuku atu ʻene fekau ki māmani: ʻoku vave ʻaupito ʻae lele atu ʻo ʻene folofola,
He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
‌ʻOku ne foaki ʻae ʻuha hinehina ʻo hangē ko e fulufuluʻi sipi: ʻoku ne tūtuuʻi ʻae hahau kuo fefeka ʻo hangē ko e efuefu.
He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
‌ʻOku ne laku atu ʻae ʻuha maka ʻo hangē ko e ngaahi momoʻi meʻa siʻi: ko hai ʻe faʻa kātaki hono momoko?
He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
‌ʻOku ne fekau atu ʻene folofola, pea ʻoku vai ai ia: ʻoku ne pule ke angi ʻene matangi, pea ʻoku tafe atu ʻae ngaahi vai.
He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
‌ʻOku ne fakahā ʻene folofola kia Sēkope, ʻa ʻene ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni mo ʻene ngaahi fakamaau ki ʻIsileli.
He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
Naʻe ʻikai te ne fai pehē ki ha puleʻanga ʻe taha: pea ko ʻene ngaahi fakamaau, naʻe ʻikai tenau ʻilo ki ai. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
Mou fakamālō kia Sihova. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova mei he ngaahi langi: fakamālō ki heʻene ʻafio ʻi he ngaahi potu māʻolunga.
Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
Mou fakamālō kiate ia, ʻa ʻene kau ʻāngelo kotoa pē: mou fakamālō kiate ia, ʻa ʻene ngaahi kautau kotoa pē.
Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
Mo fakamālō kiate ia, ʻae laʻā mo e māhina: mou fakamālō kiate ia, ʻae ngaahi fetuʻu kotoa pē ʻoe maama.
Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
Mou fakamālō kiate ia, ʻae ngaahi langi ʻoe ngaahi langi, mo e ngaahi vai ʻoku māʻolunga ʻi he ngaahi langi.
Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
Kenau fakamālō ki he huafa ʻo Sihova: he naʻe fekau ʻe ia, pea naʻe fakatupu ʻakinautolu.
Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.
Pea kuo ne fokotuʻumaʻu ʻakinautolu ʻo lauikuonga pea taʻengata. Kuo ne tuʻutuʻuni pea ʻe ʻikai mole ia.
He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
Fakamālō kia Sihova mei māmani, ʻae fanga talākoni, mo e ngaahi loloto kotoa pē:
Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
‌ʻAe afi, mo e ʻuha maka; ʻae ʻuha hinehina, mo e ngaahi kakapu; ʻae matangi mālohi ʻoku fakamoʻoni ki heʻene folofola:
Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
‌ʻAe ngaahi moʻunga, mo e ngaahi foʻi moʻunga kotoa pē; ʻae ngaahi ʻakau fua, mo e ngaahi sita kotoa pē:
Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
‌ʻAe fanga manu hehengi, mo e manu lalata kotoa pē; ʻae ngaahi meʻa totolo, mo e manupuna:
Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
‌ʻAe ngaahi tuʻi ʻo māmani, mo e kakai kotoa pē; ʻae ngaahi ʻeiki, mo e kau fakamaau kotoa pē ʻo māmani:
Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
‌ʻAe kau tangata talavou, mo e kau taʻahine; ʻae kau mātuʻa, mo e fānau:
Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
Ke nau fakamālō ki he huafa ʻo Sihova: he ko hono huafa pē ʻoku māʻolunga; mo hono nāunau ʻoku māʻolunga hake ia ʻi māmani mo e langi.
Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
‌ʻOku hiki hake foki ʻe ia ʻae nifo ʻo hono kakai, ko ia ʻoku fakamālō ai ʻa ʻene kakai māʻoniʻoni kotoa pē; ʻio, ʻa hono kakai ko ʻIsileli, ko e kakai ʻoku ofi kiate ia. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
Mou fakamālō kia Sihova. Hiva kia Sihova ʻaki ʻae hiva foʻou, mo e fakamālō kiate ia ʻi he fakataha ʻoe kakai māʻoniʻoni.
Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
Ke fiefia ʻa ʻIsileli ʻiate ia naʻa ne ngaohi ia: ke fiefia ʻae fānau ʻa Saione ʻi honau Tuʻi.
Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
Kenau fakamālō ki hono huafa ʻi he meʻe: kenau hiva fakamālō kiate ia ʻaki ʻae lali iiki mo e haʻape.
Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
He ʻoku fiefia ʻa Sihova ʻi hono kakai te ne teuteu ʻae angamalū ʻaki ʻae fakamoʻui.
For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
Ke fiefia ʻae kakai māʻoniʻoni ʻi he nāunau: kenau hiva kalanga, ʻi honau ngaahi mohenga.
Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
Ke ʻi honau ngutu ʻae fakamālō lahi ki he ʻOtua, pea ʻi honau nima ʻae heletā ʻoku fakatoumata;
Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand;
Ke ʻatu ʻae totongi ki he hiteni, mo e ngaahi tautea ki he kakai:
To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
Ke haʻisia honau ngaahi tuʻi ʻaki ʻae ukamea fihifihi, mo honau houʻeiki ʻaki ʻae ngaahi haʻi ukamea;
To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
Ke fai kiate kinautolu ʻae fakamaau kuo tohi: kuo pehē ʻae hakeakiʻi ʻo ʻene kakai māʻoniʻoni kotoa pē. Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
Mou fakamālō kia Sihova. Fakamālō kia Sihova ʻi hono faletapu: fakamālō ki heʻene ʻafio ʻi he ʻatā ʻo hono mālohi.
Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
Fakamālō kiate ia koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi ngāue lahi: fakamālō kiate ia ʻo fakatatau mo hono lahi ʻo ʻene māfimafi.
Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
Fakamālō kiate ia ʻaki ʻae leʻo ʻoe meʻa lea: fakamālō kiate ia ʻaki ʻae saliteli mo e haʻape.
Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
Fakamālō kiate ia ʻaki ʻae lali iiki mo e meʻe: fakamālō kiate ia ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa faiva mo e ngaahi meʻa ifi.
Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
Fakamālō kiate ia ʻaki ʻae simipale tatangi: fakamālō ki heʻene ʻafio ʻaki ʻae ngaahi simipale ʻoku leʻo lahi.
Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
Ke fakamālō kia Sihova ʻae meʻa kotoa pē ʻoku mānava. Haleluia.
Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
